en.pit.departure.alias_alive: Alias thanks the party and leaves. The scent of honeysuckle fills the air as Dragonbait bows and follows her.

en.zhentil.guards_question: The guards take the party aside for questioning and record Journal Entry 32.
en.zhentil.guards_warning: A guard says the party matches the little thief's description; the commander says they will get theirs inside.
en.zhentil.inner_city: You join the teeming masses of the inner city.
en.zhentil.purse-note: A note is tucked into a small pocket of the purse. The party enters it as Journal Entry 21.
en.zhentil.fritz-accusation: A legless soldier points at you and shouts, 'Yulash! You are the ones who killed Fritz!' He starts grunting incoherently and pushing himself down the street. What do you do?
en.zhentil.fritz-killed: You kill the soldier in cold blood. The crowd gasps and starts edging away.
en.zhentil.fritz-let-go: He continues down the street. The crowds have thinned out a bit.
en.journal.1.1: Journal Entry 1 (1/3): I am beginning a new journal; the old one is gone along with all of the party's equipment. We had agreed to come south to Tilverton, on the border between the Dalelands and Cormyr, to look for the lost princess Nacacia of Cormyr. Rumour said King Azoun's youngest daughter fled an arranged marriage almost a year ago and ran off with Gharri of Gond, a cleric from Tilverton. The two later fell out, and she was seen near Tilverton recently. The king has posted a large reward for her return.
en.journal.1.2: Journal Entry 1 (2/3): Somewhere on the road to Tilverton we were attacked. The brigands must have been invisible: several of us went down before we knew what was happening. I remember dark faces in evil-looking helmets firing crossbows into our midst. The bolts were not fatal, yet every hit dropped its target. I was hit in the arm; the wound blazed like fire and my head swam. Just before I blacked out I thought this was a poor end for adventurers as experienced as us.
en.journal.1.3: Journal Entry 1 (3/3): Now we wake in Tilverton with our wounds healed. Our equipment is gone, though we found a stash of coins, so buying new gear is the first priority. A servant mentioned the date; if it is true, almost a month has passed since the ambush. Each of us woke with five azure symbols imprinted on the sword arm. They are not tattoos — they seem to lie beneath the skin, and now and then they feel as though they move.
en.journal.32: Journal Entry 32: Two guards and their commander compile a detailed file on the party and insist that it is strictly routine.
en.zhentil.olive_appears: A female halfling appears from a hidden niche. You enter her statement as Journal Entry 50.
en.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: You enter the Dark Shrine through a hole in the wall made by the halfling's magical device. The walls close behind you as the device smokes and disappears.
en.zhentil.olive_explains: As Olive leads you through the dungeon, she explains about Dimswart the Sage. You record Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_door: Dimswart is just beyond this door.
en.journal.50.1: Journal Entry 50 (1/2): Olive says, “Well now, aren't we a fine bunch of adventurers. My name is Olive Ruskettle, and I know a bit about those tattoos on your arms. A friend of mine had similar marks a while back. I wonder where she is...”
en.journal.50.2: Journal Entry 50 (2/2): “Listen, you must get hold of the Amulet of Lathander. A man who can help you has been captured inside the temple. His name is Dimswart the Sage, and he helped that friend I mentioned. I know a secret way into the temple. What do you say?”
en.journal.51.1: Journal Entry 51 (1/2): “The human you seek is Dimswart. He is a very good sage and a music lover, which is why we get along. Did you know I was a bard? Yes sir, my harp is right here and I could sing for you—well, perhaps now is not the time.”
en.journal.51.2: Journal Entry 51 (2/2): “Anyway, Fzoul Chembryl captured Dimswart to learn about the other bonds. I can get you to his cell, but I need your help to free him. I'll slip out my own way; I cannot let any Banite priests see me. Only someone as slippery as I am can squeeze through the route I know.”
en.zhentil.olive_cell_hint: Olive suddenly appears and says that the man she mentioned is in the cell to the south.
en.zhentil.olive_repeats_dimswart: As Olive explains about Dimswart, you record her remarks as Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_appears: An old man is in the cell. He introduces himself, and you record his remarks as Journal Entry 12.
en.journal.12.1: Journal Entry 12 (1/6): Dimswart says, “My name is Dimswart the Sage. I am happy to meet you, though I wish it were under better circumstances. I knew others with bonds like yours and have studied them. Some symbols are now missing, but originally there must have been five—the power signs of five mighty factions joined together.”
en.journal.12.2: Journal Entry 12 (2/6): “Needless to say, all five are extremely evil. Their common purpose is to increase their collective power. Yet if this bonding follows the previous pattern—and with Moander and the Fire Knives involved I have little doubt—each evil power has its own use for you, at the others' expense. That is your greatest advantage.”
en.journal.12.3: Journal Entry 12 (3/6): “I know one bond personally. The hand with a mouth is Moander's symbol. His aspect was destroyed the last time he tried to enter this plane. Mogion, his surviving High Priestess, probably placed it upon you as part of her attempt to bring him back.”
en.journal.12.4: Journal Entry 12 (4/6): “The ornate Z inside a circle on a triangular field is the Zhentrim's mark—our hosts, I fear. They are said to hide a great hoard of lawful-good weapons and magic. I learned it is not in Zhentil Keep. Fzoul Chembryl seeks to place good people under his power so he can use these devices.”
en.journal.12.5: Journal Entry 12 (5/6): “The half moon crossed by three bars belongs to Dracandros, a powerful but banished Red Wizard of Thay obsessed with dragons. The flaming claws belong to Tyranthraxus. He is the greatest threat: he seeks dominion over the entire Prime Material Plane and controls the Pool of Radiance.”
en.journal.12.6: Journal Entry 12 (6/6): “To finish Tyranthraxus you need three artifacts divided among the powers that bonded you: the Amulet of Lathander here in Zhentil Keep, Dracandros's Helm of Dragons near Haptooth, and Mogion's Gauntlet of Moander at Yulash. I cannot offer much fighting power, but I know how to stay out of the way.”
en.wizard-tower.courtyard: You enter the wizard's tower courtyard. A magically protected five-story tower of flawless stonework rises among high mountains.
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.arrival: An impressive robed figure approaches. Dracandros says he has waited for the party and that time is short.
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.freezes-party: Dracandros orders the party to freeze; the bonds paralyze everyone.
en.wizard-tower.dragon-roof: The party suddenly stands on the tower roof amid a huge host of black dragons.
en.wizard-tower.dragon-steps-out: One black dragon disengages from the host and steps forward.
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.attack-order: Dracandros orders the party to attack the dragon as Elminster supposedly commanded.
en.wizard-tower.dragon-illusion: The bonds force the party to attack. The dragon dissolves into smoke: it was only an illusion.
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.journal-15: Dracandros freezes the party again and addresses the dragons; the speech is recorded as Journal Entry 15.
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.bond-fades: Dracandros mutters a phrase and one of the party's bonds fades.
en.wizard-tower.dragons-depart: The black dragons declare that this is a matter between humans, leave the party to its dispute, and fly away.
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.calls-troops: Dracandros calls for his troops to defend him, then flees down the stairs while the patrol attacks.
en.wizard-tower.safe-roof: The party can hold the roof well enough to rest safely here.
en.wizard-tower.dragons-convinced: The dragons accept that there is no plot against dragonkind and leave the party to settle its dispute with Dracandros.
en.wizard-tower.dragons-condemn: The dragons tell Dracandros that the party has condemned itself.
en.wizard-tower.take-dragon-heart: Dracandros escaped downstairs during the battle, and black dragon bodies lie across the roof. Will the party take one of their hearts?
en.wizard-tower.dragon-bodies: Dracandros escaped downstairs during the battle, and black dragon bodies lie across the roof.
en.wizard-tower.dragon-heart-acid: The party cuts into a dragon and is sprayed with acid, but succeeds in extracting its heart.
en.wizard-tower.wilderness-exit: Will the party stop by Haptooth Village or depart the area?
en.wizard-tower.roof-exit: A route leads down to the caves, and a secret passage leads directly to the wilderness. Which way will the party go?
en.wizard-tower.stairs.up: The stairs here lead up. Will the party climb them?
en.wizard-tower.stairs.down: The stairs here lead down. Will the party descend?
en.wizard-tower.dracandros.final-challenge: Dracandros drags a heavy bag across the courtyard, drops it, and declares the party has dogged his steps too long.
en.wizard-tower.helm-of-dragons: The Helm of Dragons is among his treasures.
en.wizard-tower.laboratory.pool: A mystical laboratory holds a murky, shallow pool that smells of rotting vegetation. Will the party go forward?
en.wizard-tower.laboratory.pool-depth: The pool looks several feet deep and the bottom is not visible. Will the party reach into it?
en.wizard-tower.laboratory.ellipsoid: In the muck the party finds a warm, faintly pulsing leathery ellipsoid the size of a head. Will they take it?
en.wizard-tower.sphere-trial.sign: A sign over a black door reads 'Trial of the Sphere. One challenger only.' Does anyone wish to enter?
en.wizard-tower.sphere-trial.chamber: A young mage in red holds a silvery rod in a dim room. A dead black sphere floats between him and the challenger.
en.wizard-tower.sphere-trial.rules: The mage explains that the sphere of annihilation destroys whatever it touches, only a mage can steer it, and the challenger may surrender at any time.
en.wizard-tower.dark-elf-owlbear-guard: Dark elves with owl bears guard this area.
en.wizard-tower.dragon-pen: A reptilian stench fills a room of massive chains and huge, empty collars. A deep growl comes from across the room.
en.wizard-tower.bedroom: An elegant bedroom hung with red silk tapestries is in disarray, as if someone packed in a hurry. Will the party take the time to loot it?
en.wizard-tower.library: The walls are lined with books on many subjects. None of them radiate magic.
en.wizard-tower.scroll-room: Racks for scroll cases cover the walls. The scrolls look to have been removed recently.
en.wizard-tower.identical-dark-elf: At the base of this set of stairs stands a dark elf nearly identical to the one the party faced at the last stairs.
en.wizard-tower.pass-for-items: “You may pass if I can select some of your items and money.” Will the party pay?
en.wizard-tower.another-illusion: He takes some items and walks off. Refusing to back down, the party rushes the dark elf — and he disappears in a puff of smoke, another illusion. On the floor lies a folded piece of paper titled “Avoiding Tower Traps.” Does the party pick it up and read it?
en.wizard-tower.avoid-explosive-rune: The party avoids reading an explosive rune and discovers a way past the trap at the next stairway.
en.wizard-tower.spike-trap: The bottom set of stairs goes flat, propelling the party into a set of upthrust spikes — but they find the hidden button mentioned in the note and bypass the spike trap.
en.wizard-tower.salamanders: A sulphurous smell assaults the party as they meet salamanders.
en.wizard-tower.dark-elf-party: A party of dark elves approaches.
en.wizard-tower.armored-contingent: An armoured contingent of dark elves charges.
en.wizard-tower.shield-of-pain: Guarding the stairs is a burly dark elf in plate and shield. He raises his shield at the party's approach, revealing a symbol of pain; as everyone writhes in agony, he wordlessly attacks.
en.wizard-tower.takes-items-walks-off: He takes some items and walks off.
en.wizard-tower.puff-of-smoke: Refusing to back down, the party rushes the dark elf — and he disappears in a puff of smoke, another illusion.
en.wizard-tower.folded-paper: On the floor is a folded piece of paper titled “Avoiding Tower Traps.” Does the party pick it up and read it?
en.wizard-tower.explosive-rune-note: The note says, “1. Do not read explosive runes.” The paper then explodes.
en.wizard-tower.stairs-go-flat: The bottom set of stairs goes flat, propelling the party into a set of upthrust spikes.
en.wizard-tower.hidden-button: The party finds the hidden button mentioned in the note and bypasses the spike trap.
en.wizard-tower.sphere-kills-wizard: As the sphere reaches the Red Wizard he raises his rod in panic. The two meet in a tremendous explosion that rocks the building, leaving nothing of either sphere or man.
en.wizard-tower.chests-valuables: The chests lining the walls contain many valuables.
en.wizard-tower.spoils-for-the-victor: The sphere halts between them. The Red Wizard then has the party drop some items and money. He smiles and says, “Spoils for the victor.” Suddenly they are outside.
en.wizard-tower.sucked-into-sphere: The sphere reaches one of the party, who is sucked into it and gone forever. An efreeti leads a band of dark elves against the rest.
en.journal.15.1: Journal Entry 15 (1/2): Dracandros tells the dragons that Elminster sent the party to exterminate dragonkind in revenge for their raids. He offers the supposed assassins as proof of his goodwill and falsely identifies the marks on their arms as the sign of Tyranthraxus, who enslaves dragons.
en.journal.15.2: Journal Entry 15 (2/2): One black dragon has seen similar glowing bonds control warriors and accuses Dracandros of being the true master. It threatens him with smoking acid and demands that he remove his bond before the dragons judge the party. Dracandros reluctantly speaks the phrase that makes his mark fade.
en.zhentil.hooded_offer: A hooded woman suddenly appears. “Follow me. I can get you out of here! You are trapped here! My master can help you.”
en.zhentil.fzoul_interrupts: A strange shimmer surrounds you and the room begins to fade. A band of clerics bursts in, led by Fzoul Chembryl. He shouts, “Woman, you go too far!”
en.zhentil.fzoul_retreats: As the room fades away, Fzoul turns and rushes out.
en.dexam.arrival: You are led along a dark corridor and see Dexam the beholder. The hooded woman walks toward a milling group of armored minotaurs; they immediately snap to attention.
en.dexam.journal_30: Dexam speaks. You record his speech as Journal Entry 30.
en.dexam.amulet_choice: Dimswart the Sage whispers, “Look on the altar. That is the Amulet of Lathander.” What do you do?
en.dexam.fzoul_journal_7: Before you can act, an impressive man backed by troops, priests and mages rushes in. His statement is recorded as Journal Entry 7.
en.dexam.kills_fzoul: Dexam roars, “Then die, heretic!” and blasts Fzoul into a heap of ash. The bonds on your arms begin to writhe.
en.dexam.kill_order: “Now that the bond is gone, they are of no use to me. Kill them.”
en.dexam.amulet_rises: Dexam turns toward the altar and starts to leave. You notice the amulet rising to meet him.
en.dexam.altar_melee: As Dexam leaves, his forces and Fzoul's remaining troops begin to melee around you.
en.dexam.final_reveal: You have caught up with Dexam and his minions. The hooded woman casts off her disguise—she is a medusa!
en.dexam.amulet_retrieved: You retrieve the Amulet of Lathander from Dexam's mangled remains.
en.dexam.zhentil_attack: Forces of Zhentil Keep attack you!
en.dexam.departure.olive: Olive Ruskettle appears just outside the door. She says, “So, you made it. I'm surprised.”
en.dexam.departure.dimswart: “Dimswart, you come with me. A man from Shadowdale has some questions for you.” Olive and Dimswart leave.
en.dexam.departure.gharri: You see a rider in the distance. He stops suddenly, and a moment later you hear something like “Gharriiii” drifting through the air.
en.dexam.departure.riders: The rider changes direction and gallops to a woman dressed in purple. They embrace; she climbs onto the horse, and they ride away.
en.dexam.dead-elf.remains: You see the remains of an elf fighter.
en.dexam.dead-elf.pouch: Buried beneath the moldering clothing, you find a leather pouch.
en.dexam.dead-elf.pouch-moves: The pouch moves. You hear the crackling of something like paper and the clink of metal.
en.dexam.dead-elf.map: You discover a map. It marks Dexam's altar.
en.dexam.dead-elf.drop-pouch: You drop the pouch and leave.
en.dexam.dimswart-whispers: The party wakes in a confusion of voices. The old man introduces himself as Dimswart the Sage, and his hurried whispers are recorded as Journal Entry 12.
en.dexam.walls-blur: The walls around blur to a grey smear.
en.dexam.slammed-against-wall: The party is suddenly slammed against a wall.
en.dexam.dark-shape-archway: A dark shape scuttles through the archway ahead and to the left. Noise comes from the wall to the west — medusae and their bodyguards attack!
en.dexam.arrow-trap-and-medusa: An arrow trap goes off! The party feels very strange. A band of fighters bursts through the door behind them. This room is covered with dark red stains, chains are embedded in the walls and piles of bones are scattered about; a medusa looks up from a grisly meal.
en.dexam.round-shape-turns: A large round shape slowly turns towards the party.
en.dexam.man-cowers-beholder-corps: A man cowers in the shadows. He gasps, “The Beholder Corps is… gaak!”
en.dexam.beholder-conference-warning: A large round shape disappears into the darkness. A beholder floats in front of the party: “You are not of the creatures invited to this conference. However, the Corps is merciful. Go now, if you value your lives.”
en.dexam.guards-cower: Local guards cower back at the party's approach.
en.dexam.drow-examines-card: A large drow examines a small card. He looks up at the party and draws his weapon.
en.dexam.beholders-floating-object: Several beholders are gathered around a small floating object. As the party enters, one of them looks up and notices them.
en.dexam.conference-table: The party enters a room dominated by a large conference table. On each side sits an assemblage of rakshasa, drow, priests and beholders, discussing the fate of adventurers.
en.dexam.teleport-jerk: A gut-wrenching jerk slams the party's stomachs against their spines; it feels like being fired from a cannon.
en.dexam.discovers-a-trap: Someone discovers a trap! What will the party do?
en.dexam.stop-theres-a-trap: Someone suddenly yells, “Stop! There's a trap!” What will the party do?
en.dexam.minotaurs-and-priests: The party is attacked by a band of minotaurs and priests.
en.dexam.clash-of-weapons: The clash of weapons comes from the distance.
en.dexam.water-trickles: Water trickles down the sides of the cave.
en.dexam.letters-as: The letters “A.S.” are scratched into the wall.
en.dexam.ground-trembles: The ground begins to tremble and shake. It builds to a loud rumble and slowly dies away; small rocks clatter from the ceiling.
en.dexam.muffled-grunts: The party hears the muffled grunts and growls of several large animals.
en.dexam.torn-parchment: The party finds a partially destroyed piece of parchment. It reads: “…in the northwest… the way out… archway and west.”
en.dexam.beholder-unaware: A beholder floats in the dark shadows ahead. Its main eye is turned away and it does not seem to notice the party. What will they do?
en.dexam.actually-a-gas-spore: Passing cautiously by, the party discovers that what they took for a beholder was actually a gas spore — and breathes a sigh of relief at not having attacked it.
en.dexam.thats-not-a-beholder: The party easily sneaks up on the floating monster. As the sword descends in savage fury, Dimswart yells, “Wait! That's not a beholder, it's…!!!”
en.dexam.gas-spore-explodes-on-you: Too late: the sword pierces the gas spore, which explodes and covers the party in a heavy, choking gas.
en.dexam.tower-of-oxam-rumor: “The Mulmaster Beholder Corps is rumoured to be holed up in the Tower of Oxam.”
en.dexam.manor-foyer: The party is in the foyer of the manor.
en.dexam.sitting-room: This is the remains of a large sitting room.
en.dexam.library: This is the library; many old books line the shelves.
en.dexam.books-crumble: Every book the party touches crumbles into ashes. There is nothing here.
en.dexam.image-welcomes: An image forms in front of the party: “Welcome, my friends. I await your arrival. In the meanwhile, have some fun with my pets.”
en.dexam.high-priest-of-bane: Before the party stands a high priest of Bane.
en.dexam.dark-shape-archway-only: A dark shape scuttles through the archway ahead and to the left.
en.dexam.noise-from-west-wall: Noise comes from the wall to the west.
en.dexam.red-stained-room: This room is covered with dark red stains. Chains are embedded in the walls and piles of bones are scattered about.
en.dexam.medusa-grisly-meal: A medusa looks up from a grisly meal.
en.dexam.gas-spore-explodes: The gas spore explodes at the touch of the party's weapons.
en.dexam.round-shape-disappears: A large round shape disappears into the darkness.
en.dexam.corps-is-merciful: A beholder floats in front of the party: “You are not of the creatures invited to this conference. However, the Corps is merciful. Go now, if you value your lives.”
en.dexam.furry-faces: The guards get very strange, wicked smiles on their suddenly furry faces.
en.dexam.invitation-card: The party finds a small, elegant card: “The High Imperceptor of Mulmaster commands your presence at the Tower of Oxam. The Beholder Corps will be your hosts.”
en.dexam.attendance-list: Rakshasa — yes. Efreeti — no. Vampire — no. Drow — yes. Lich — no.
en.dexam.circular-stairway: A circular stairway leads down. Does the party want to go down?
en.journal.59: Journal Entry 59: A map of the Cave of the Beholder. Its key marks doors, arched doorways, animal noises, minotaur grunts or shouts, Dexam's Shrine, and the altar.
en.world.shadowdale.edge: You are at the edge of Shadowdale. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.world.magic-shop: The party discovers a small magic shop. What will they do?
en.world.drow-items-fade: After a few hours in the sun, the party's drow items fade and become useless.
en.world.night-note.24: One morning the party finds a note pinned to a companion's chest and reads it as Journal Entry 24.
en.journal.30.1: Journal Entry 30 (1/2): Dexam says, “So, these are Fzoul's little secret. Very interesting. As the representative of the TRUE priests of Bane, I shall deliver you to Mulmaster and the grand Imperceptor.”
en.journal.30.2: Journal Entry 30 (2/2): “In Mulmaster I will examine these bonds in my laboratory—to your extreme discomfort. During the final procedure, the one resulting in your death, the pain should last no more than two or perhaps three weeks. Once I uncover their secret, the Imperceptor will be most angry with dear little Fzoul, and we may finally be rid of this heretic and his precious mages.”
en.journal.7.1: Journal Entry 7 (1/2): “I am Fzoul Chembryl, high lord of the Dark Shrine. My precious mages, as you call them, allowed me to follow your minion. Dexam, you overstep your authority. My mark is on these people, and the Imperceptor will know of my work in due time.”
en.journal.7.2: Journal Entry 7 (2/2): “I work for the greater glory of Bane. The powers Bane granted us, joined with secular magic-users, will establish a Banite hegemony in the Realms. These bonded tools are central to our power and will let me control and evade the traps of lawful and good magic. They are under my authority and shall remain so for as long as I live.”
en.myth-drannor.tyranthraxus-reveal: The bonds reveal Tyranthraxus. He commands you to meet him at Myth Drannor.
en.myth-drannor.edge: You are at the edge of Myth Drannor. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.myth-drannor.helm-north: The Helm of Dragons reports that Tyranthraxus is to the north.
en.myth-drannor.inner.helm-northeast: The Helm of Dragons shows Tyranthraxus on the second floor, in the northeast corner.
en.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.greeting: An elfish spirit appears and greets you. What do you do?
en.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.journal-25: The spirit tells you about the glen. You record Journal Entry 25, and then the spirit fades.
en.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.flee: “So, you are sheep! Then you shall feed me.” The spirit fades.
en.myth-drannor.red-web: A red web stretches across the passage, glowing dully.
en.myth-drannor.red-web.hack: As you strike, the glow fades from the webs, revealing several wire snares as well. In the distance you hear cursing, then running feet.
en.myth-drannor.red-web.rakshasa: The spirit appears laughing. It fades, revealing a rakshasa.
en.myth-drannor.grave.thri-kreen: A thri-kreen is excavating a grave. At your approach it turns and attacks.
en.myth-drannor.grave.skeleton: You see a partially excavated elf skeleton. Jewelry glitters on its wrist. What will you do?
en.myth-drannor.daemir.offer: A spirit appears before you. “I am the spirit of Princess Daemir. You seem good people. Will you accept my blessing?”
en.myth-drannor.daemir.forgiveness-offer: A spirit appears before you. “I am the spirit of Princess Daemir. You have despoiled the glen—perhaps from ignorance. If you kneel now, you may accept my forgiveness.”
en.myth-drannor.daemir.blessing: “Go forth with my blessing.” She fades away.
en.myth-drannor.daemir.curse: “You presume too much! As long as you are in Myth Drannor, your weapons will twist in your hands.” She fades away.
en.myth-drannor.phase-spider-wall: As you enter, spiders come out of the solid walls.
en.myth-drannor.phase-spider-glowing: Glowing spiders skitter forward at your approach.
en.myth-drannor.phase-spider-bones: Spiders have gathered a pile of bones here and defend it.
en.myth-drannor.bones.prompt: What do you do with the bones?
en.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.entrance: A party of thri-kreen bars your entrance.
en.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.bivouac: The thri-kreen have bivouacked here. They prepare to make a stand.
en.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.reinforcements: Other thri-kreen respond to the noise.
en.myth-drannor.spider-mausoleum: Webs festoon this mausoleum. The webs are inhabited.
en.myth-drannor.spider-funnel: You see a funnel of webs.
en.myth-drannor.spider-warning: A whispery voice calls out, “The spiders will guard their nest fiercely.” Do you continue?
en.myth-drannor.spider-eggs: Spiders leap forth. You can see some eggs behind them.
en.myth-drannor.court.entry: Near the building entrance lies a crushed thri-kreen. A ghostly shape stands in the doorway.
en.myth-drannor.court.enter: Do you want to enter the building?
en.myth-drannor.court.welcome: The spirit says, “Welcome, warriors. Enter and meet our Queen.”
en.myth-drannor.court.armor: Two suits of armor flank this stairway, radiating faint magic. One says, “The Queen will see you.”
en.myth-drannor.court.armor-bows: The armor seems to bow as you pass.
en.myth-drannor.court.armor-crumbles: The armor crumbles into rusty flakes.
en.myth-drannor.court.greeting: As you approach the stairs, a voice calls, “The court gives greetings.”
en.myth-drannor.court.hostile: As you approach the stairs, a voice calls, “Despoilers shall fight despoilers.”
en.myth-drannor.court.reward: A spirit appears. “My heart rejoices to have such defenders. These items may help your quest.”
en.myth-drannor.court.farewell: “Alas, my time is short here. My best wishes to you.” She disappears.
en.myth-drannor.court.hostile-offer: A spirit appears. “This glen has been crushed by your kind. If you leave, you may have the remnants of our treasure. Will you?”
en.myth-drannor.court.refusal: “Then lie with us!” The tower begins to collapse around you. You rush outside.
en.myth-drannor.court.collapse: The tower falls into a pile of rubble.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.gesture: A Red Plume makes a gesture of friendship.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.journal: The Red Plume tells you his tale. You record Journal Entry 33. What will you do?
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.warning: “Follow me.” A whispery voice cries, “Beware—a trap!” The Red Plume snarls and silences the voice with a gesture.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.refusal: “Then I shall try myself.” He goes through the gate. Suddenly, a scream pierces the air. Will you investigate?
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.spiders: Within an unearthed grave, glowing spiders swarm out to protect their eggs.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.reveal: Within an unearthed grave, glowing spiders swarm out to protect their eggs. The Red Plume steps away and fires at you—his shape changes.
en.myth-drannor.clan-figure.greeting: A figure appears from the shadows. “Hail, bonded ones!”
en.myth-drannor.clan-figure.journal: The figure launches into rapid speech. You record Journal Entry 56. “Hurry on, hurry, hurry!” He leaves.
en.myth-drannor.more-ruins: You are heading toward more ruins. Will you travel by a path or through the woods?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.greeting: A rakshasa with matted fur and a dour expression comes around the corner and makes a gesture of peace. What do you do?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.tale: The rakshasa says, “I am Tirsheya.” He tells his tale, which you record as Journal Entry 5. Will you go with him?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.guards: “Then come with me.” The entrance is guarded. Do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.beyrha-arriv: The battle draws another rakshasa and his retinue. He accuses Tirsheya of robbing the clan.
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.ultimatum: Beyrha says, “Humans, bring me Tirsheya's head and you will be forgiven; otherwise you will be tonight's main dish.” Whom do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.attack-beyrh: “You are fools, but we will thank you at dinner.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.name: Tirsheya
en.myth-drannor.outer.beyrha.name: Beyrha
en.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.guards: Some margoyles and hell hounds guard the entrance to this building. They prepare for combat. Do you flee?
en.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.supplies: Piled within this building is a large array of foodstuffs, clothing, and trinkets.
en.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.valuables: Piled within this building is a large array of foodstuffs, clothing, and trinkets. Eventually, you find a few valuables.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.intro: Ahead, you see a man running near exhaustion, chased by a pack of hell hounds. He stumbles and collapses. Do you go to the rescue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.killed: The hounds leap upon the man and tear him to shreds. They soon finish their work. Do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.clue: The man thanks you and whispers, “I hid it before I was captured…a ruined building…northeast. Your reward.” His breathing stops.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.remains: The hounds left little that can be recognized as human. You find nothing of value.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.cache: Just as the dying man described, you locate a hidden cache.
en.myth-drannor.outer.nameless-warning: Nameless slides out of the shadows and says, “This direct approach is dangerous, but the temple is to the north. Now get on with it!” Then he leaves.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-decoy: Dense brush fills the plaza ahead. A small child—or perhaps a halfling—runs over and dives into it as a hell hound tries to leap in after him. Do you go to the rescue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-rescue: You arrive before the hell hound can force its way into the brush and cut it down.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-ambush: A rakshasa stands up from the brush and says, “Why, thank you. Such kindness should be rewarded.” At his gesture, margoyles on the nearby roofs pelt you with rocks.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-attack: The monsters then leap down to attack.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-victim: After a moment, the hell hound emerges from the brush with something bloody in its mouth and trots off.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-bloodstains: The brush is dense and filled with rubble. A few bloodstains mark the leaves.
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-trap: Two margoyles are torturing a small animal in a doorway just ahead. They are unaware of you. Do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-collapse: You swiftly kill them. Laughter sounds behind you, and the doorway collapses onto the party.
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-rakshasa: A rakshasa approaches while you are buried. Do you play dead?
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-surprise: You surprise him as he reaches for you.
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-retreat: Seeing that the collapse failed to finish you, he turns and disappears.
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-margoyle: A lone margoyle skitters away, uncovering a sewer grate. It seems to be trying to flee. Do you let it?
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-escape: It runs down through the sewer and disappears.
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-kill: You slaughter it where it stands.
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-grate: There is a sewer grate here. Do you want to enter?
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-warning: A dreamlike voice in your head warns, “Great danger lies before you. Be fully prepared!” Do you still continue?
en.myth-drannor.kitchen-arrival: The sewer ends in a darkened kitchen. A rumble and cloud of dust force you from the tunnel.
en.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-room: In this opulent room, male rakshasas gamble with dice while females lounge on pillows and margoyles watch intently.
en.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-rise: They finally notice you and slowly rise. Do you flee?
en.myth-drannor.inner.bedroom: You enter an elegant bedroom with a four-poster bed, tapestries, and gold fixtures. Do you want to loot the room?
en.myth-drannor.inner.office: This room has been converted to an office. The walls are covered with icons of Bane.
en.myth-drannor.inner.kitchen: You enter the kitchen. Slaves dive under the tables at your arrival; they are no threat to you.
en.myth-drannor.inner.kennel: A sulfurous smell assaults your nostrils. This room has been converted into a kennel, and its inhabitants rise at your approach.
en.myth-drannor.inner.statuary: The room seems filled with bones and hideous statuary—until the statues begin to move.
en.myth-drannor.inner.minions-attack: Minions of Tyranthraxus rush to attack you.
en.myth-drannor.inner.chapel: You enter an elegant private chapel. A well-dressed elderly man is seated here.
en.myth-drannor.inner.chapel-priest: “So you are Tyranthraxus's grand tools. I could ask you to surrender, but Bane has favored him too much of late. It would hurt him more if you died. So sorry.” Other priests slip up beside him.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.arrival: As you enter, a voice commands you to step forward. Unable to control yourselves, you walk into the center of the room.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.control: “Through the bonds, you are mine to control. Follow me!”
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.journal: Tyranthraxus delivers a speech, which you record as Journal Entry 48.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.hand-over: “Hand your toys over to my priest.” You resist with all your might, but the party is compelled to surrender the three artifacts.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.dispose-order: “Now, priest, dispose of these unpleasant items through the Pool.”
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.pool: With a graceful flourish, the priest arcs each artifact into the Pool. It swirls, and the items vanish.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.parchment: Tyranthraxus produces a parchment bearing the phrase that releases your bonds and orders the priest to dispose of it through the Pool.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.final-spell: “You bonded ones, come with me. It is time to complete the final spell.”
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.nameless-revea: The priest throws back his hood: it is Nameless. Crying, “It won't be that easy!”, he tosses the artifacts back to you.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.nameless-falls: Tyranthraxus strikes Nameless down with one blow. With his last breath, Nameless mouths the apparently meaningless phrase written on the parchment.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.bonds-fade: The bonds' control fades, but Tyranthraxus's sigil remains. He warns that only he can remove it and that the party will soon be his again.
en.myth-drannor.inner.ritual.recover: As you recover the artifacts, Tyranthraxus looks afraid. He orders his pets to kill you, then rushes away.
en.myth-drannor.inner.magic-circle: A high priest is summoning Bane's power here. Blue lightning strikes as you enter the magic circle.
en.myth-drannor.inner.food-storeroom: Rats skitter beneath the sacks as you open this food storeroom.
en.myth-drannor.inner.library: Shelves of mouldering books line this room.
en.myth-drannor.inner.biers: The room contains old biers and caskets.
en.myth-drannor.inner.preservation-room: The stench of preserving fluid is strong. Wrapped forms on the northern tables seem to shift and rise.
en.myth-drannor.inner.preservation-illusion: You soon realize the light is playing tricks on your eyes.
en.myth-drannor.inner.stairs-up: Stairs lead upward here. Do you want to go up?
en.myth-drannor.inner.stairs-down: Stairs lead downward here. Do you want to descend?
en.myth-drannor.inner.final-compulsion: “The power of your bonds has returned. Grovel at my feet this instant!” Your bodies begin to bow.
en.myth-drannor.inner.final-defiance: With a tremendous effort of will, you overcome the compulsion. Tyranthraxus roars, “So be it! Here is your destiny—ground to dust beneath my feet!”
en.myth-drannor.inner.final-amulet: He scowls. “That amulet will let you scratch me, but it is far from enough to defeat me. For my greater glory, let your lives be forfeit!”
en.myth-drannor.inner.bonds-returning: The bonds writhe beneath your skin. Their power is slowly returning.
en.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-residence: A rakshasa resides here in splendor.
en.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-threat: The rakshasa stands as several more appear. “To disturb one of my rank invites death. Prepare for yours.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-parlay: The rakshasa smiles. “Your boldness is refreshing.” He tells his story, which you record as Journal Entry 57.
en.myth-drannor.inner.door-resists: This door resists all attempts to open it.
en.myth-drannor.inner.bands-deny-rest: The bonds will not let the party rest.
en.myth-drannor.inner.temple-alarm: A tremendous noise comes from outside; some of Tyranthraxus's force leaves to protect the temple.
en.myth-drannor.outer.heading-wilderness: The party is heading toward the wilderness.
en.myth-drannor.outer.no-quarrel: “We have no quarrel with him.” They leave. — “That is unknown. Die!”
en.myth-drannor.outer.harper-diversion: “Your cause is just. When you are in the temple, we will cause a diversion to draw off some troops. Good luck!”
en.myth-drannor.outer.reports-from-tilverto: “We have had reports of you from Tilverton, where you helped a brother.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.you-are-offensive: “You are offensive. We leave you to your fate.” They leave.
en.myth-drannor.outer.spirit-raises-arms: As the party moves forward the spirit raises its arms, and rocks and tombstones whirl around them.
en.myth-drannor.outer.armor-guards-queen: Two suits of armour flank this stairway, radiating faint magic. One speaks: “Your kind may not see the queen.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.monsters-move-off: The monsters stop their attack, growl and move off.
en.myth-drannor.outer.do-not-let-us-find-yo: “Do not let us find you again.” They leave. — The monsters don't like the party's response.
en.myth-drannor.outer.beyrha-you-may-leave: Beyrha speaks: “You have done well. You may leave.” Does the party leave?
en.myth-drannor.inner.sewer-collapsed: The sewer has collapsed; this is no longer a way out.
en.myth-drannor.ruins.eerie-block: The party has found an eerie block of ruins.
en.myth-drannor.ruins.priest-and-pirates: A priest is arguing with some pirates about a map. They seem unaware of the party. What will they do?
en.myth-drannor.ruins.marked-area-treasure: The party finds the area marked on the map. A stone underfoot seems loose; shifting it reveals a treasure.
en.myth-drannor.ruins.pirates-digging: Some pirates are busily digging here. Suddenly one shouts: “Hold it, mates. We been spotted. Keel haul 'em!” The pirates rush forward.
en.myth-drannor.outer.thri-kreen-master: A thri-kreen steps forward, asking, “Who is your master?” What does the party say?
en.myth-drannor.outer.no-quarrel-with-him: “We have no quarrel with him.” They leave.
en.myth-drannor.outer.group-of-knights: The party sees a group of knights.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fades-away: As if exhausted, it fades away.
en.myth-drannor.outer.spears-crossed: The suits cross their spears across the entrance. Does the party continue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.ruined-temple: The party is heading toward a large ruined temple. Do they continue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.graveyard: The party is heading into the graveyard. Do they continue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.yell-a-word: There is time to yell but a single word before the beasts are upon the party. (Type a single word.)
en.myth-drannor.outer.do-not-find-you-again: “Do not let us find you again.” They leave.
en.myth-drannor.outer.dislike-your-response: The monsters don't like the party's response.
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya-sprints-away: As the party pulls its weapons, Tirsheya shrugs his shoulders and then sprints away.
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya-dejected: Looking dejected, Tirsheya turns and leaves.
en.myth-drannor.outer.guards-notice: Before the party can pull back, the guards notice them. Do they run?
en.myth-drannor.outer.betrayal-cost: Tirsheya snarls, “Your betrayal will not be without cost.” He attacks.
en.myth-drannor.outer.proves-his-cheating: Tirsheya runs into the storehouse and comes out a moment later with some papers: “This proves his cheating. Take what you wish from the storehouse. Good day.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.moves-away-quickly: He moves quickly away before the party can stop him.
en.myth-drannor.outer.guards-cant-decide: As the party flees, Tirsheya runs in a different direction. The guards can't decide whom to chase, so the party gets away.
en.myth-drannor.inner.monsters-confused: The monsters look confused and wander away.
en.myth-drannor.inner.tiered-beds: Tiered beds line the walls, filled with meditating priests. They aren't happy about being disturbed.
en.myth-drannor.inner.worshipping-priests: The room is filled with worshipping priests. They note the party's entry with anger.
en.myth-drannor.inner.hidden-valuables: A few valuables are hidden away here.
en.myth-drannor.ruins.hidden-stone-note: The party finds a note: “Seek the hidden stone; beneath it lies the river pirates' treasure.”
en.myth-drannor.ruins.cryptic-map: The party finds a cryptic map marked with an X.
en.myth-drannor.ruins.hidden-pinnace: A small pinnace is hidden here. Wet footprints lead off, and it appears something heavy was being dragged.
en.journal.25: Journal Entry 25: We spirits of Myth Drannor have grown weak over the centuries and can now do little but observe. We ask for your help. In return, here is a secret power of the thri-kreen: within this building is a glowing red web. Speak the word Krrkik while standing before it, then walk into it, and you will gain great strength. I have seen many thri-kreen do this.
en.journal.33: Journal Entry 33: “I am Caemir, and my ancestors lived and died here in Myth Drannor. Evil dreams have shown my grandfather's tomb turned into a nest for foul spider creatures. Help me lay his spirit to rest, and I will give you the bow he made.” He shows you an exquisitely crafted bow radiating powerful magic.
en.journal.56: Journal Entry 56: The man refuses to give his name, saying that names are labels for things people do not understand. He knows of the bonds and the party's struggle because he helped create the first bonds long ago. The final bond, Tyranthraxus's, is the most dangerous: Tyranthraxus no longer shares control and can devote his full fury to preventing escape. The party must surprise and defeat him before he invokes the bonds. The man's clan is resting here for several mortal lifetimes, but Tyranthraxus stole their followers and threatened them. They hate him yet cannot attack his temple directly. When the party attacks, the clan will reclaim its followers, perhaps weakening Tyranthraxus enough for victory.
en.journal.57: Journal Entry 57: “It is good to speak with those with confidence enough to deal. My clan has taken this spot as a place to rest for a few mortal lifetimes. But Tyranthraxus, the Flamed One, has stolen our followers and threatened my clan. His power is such that we cannot attack his temple directly, though we hate him with great passion. Now to our deal. You wear the Flamed One's mark, but I have been told you are his enemy. When you attack his temple we will bend our power to reclaim our followers. That may weaken him enough for you to be victorious.”
en.journal.48: Journal Entry 48: “You have done well, my pets. The three artifacts that can harm me are now in my possession. More importantly, the bonds you wear can act as the Pool of Radiance does. Through them I can transfer into any of your bodies and use it for as long as I need. If that body is killed, I can transfer through the bond back to the Pool—or into another one of you. I must thank you for the freedom you have given me. Now come along, and we will dispose of those dangerous objects.”
en.journal.46: Journal Entry 46: Fzoul Chembryl orders Mogion not to destroy the test subjects before the experiment is complete. If she disobeys, he, Dracandros, and Lord T will hunt her down. A correction adds that the three gauntlets—not Moander's physical form—can consume the Pool of Radiance.
en.journal.5: Journal Entry 5: “We rakshasas are very fond of gambling. I suffered a streak of bad luck and lost most of my possessions. Recently I discovered that Birsheya had been cheating, but the clan lord will not act without proof. Birsheya guards the clan storehouse, and I know evidence is hidden there. Help me break in and you may choose whatever you want from the storehouse; I want only proof of Birsheya's cheating.”
en.press_button: PRESS BUTTON OR RETURN TO CONTINUE.
en.teshwave.left-in-charge: The troopers go to alert Teshwave and leave the party in charge of the bugbears and worgs. The party's forces are impatient and wish to begin the march.
en.teshwave.bugbears-rescue: Bugbears and worgs come to the rescue of the troopers.
en.teshwave.reach-dagger-falls: The party escapes the monsters and reaches Dagger Falls ahead of them. The city mobilises and routs the disorganised creatures, and the Zhentarim rescue force is politely turned back to Teshwave.
en.teshwave.keys-to-the-city: As a reward the party is given the keys to the city, and a great feast and parade are held in their honour.
en.teshwave.monsters-infight: On the long road to Dagger Falls the monsters begin to fight amongst themselves. One night their leaders decide they should command alone.
en.teshwave.sweep-down-melee: The party sweeps down upon the Zhentarim forces as they prepare to march on Dagger Falls, and a vast melee ensues.
en.teshwave.both-routed: The forces turn out to be closely matched: both the troopers and the monsters are routed, Teshwave itself suffers only minor damage, and the monsters flee into the wilds.
en.teshwave.army-melts-away: Bereft of effective leadership, the army of monsters melts into the wilds.
en.tell_her_none_of_affair: TELL HER IT'S NONE OF HER AFFAIR
en.opening.curse-summary: On your way to Tilverton, you are ambushed, captured, and knocked unconscious. You awaken cursed with five azure symbols that bind your will. When the bonds glow, you must obey. Your only hope is to find the alliance that created them and regain control of your destiny. Nowhere in the Realms is completely safe; even a peaceful scene may hide a deadly foe.
en.opening.new-game-awakening: You awaken in a small room. All your gear is gone, along with your memory of recent events.
en.opening.new-game-marks: Adding to your disquiet, strange patterns have been imprinted on every party member's sword arm.
en.opening.demo-closing: The risk of adventure is great but the rewards are greater; fame and fortune come to those who brave the wilds. The ultimate prize is not gold or power but control of your own destiny, and to win it you must defeat the ultimate enemy. Your enemies are prepared and the Realms await: go forward and defeat the New Alliance, to be free of the curse of the azure bonds.
en.hap.black-dragons: Great black shapes sail across the sky and swoop down: three fearsome black dragons.
en.hap.edge: You are at the edge of Hap. Will you enter the village or continue your journey?
en.hap.abandoned-village: The run-down village is strangely quiet. Wind howls through empty streets and shuttered windows; no one is about.
en.hap.hiding-peasants: You burst in on peasants who shrink back and beg you to leave before the horde finds you with them. What do you do?
en.hap.peasants-flee: The cringing peasants flee into the street.
en.hap.dark-elf-attack: The dark elves curse your ingratitude and promise you a quick death.
en.hap.akabar-join: Akabar Bel Akash introduces himself and proposes joining forces against the dark tide. Will you let him join the party?
en.hap.inn-before-liberation: A surly innkeeper warns that monsters are outside. You may stay if you keep quiet. Do you stay?
en.hap.efreet-barn: The barn is empty except for an efreet and his dark-elven cohorts.
en.hap.efreet-threat: The efreet roars that it will kill you, burn the village, and make you responsible for its doom.
en.hap.efreet-map: On the efreet's body you find a map showing the village and a cave.
en.hap.liberated-crowd: Soon after the battle fades, villagers gather and the village fills with cheers and laughter.
en.hap.elder-thanks: A village elder thanks you and says you will always be welcome in Haptooth.
en.hap.elder-wizard-tower: The elder warns that the dark elves are controlled from the nearby wizard's tower; the village will not be safe until that nest is destroyed.
en.hap.akabar-secret-routes: Akabar knows secret trade routes around the wizard's tower and offers to guide the party.
en.hap.leave: You are heading back to the wilderness. Do you want to continue?
en.hap.map-route: Will you follow the map to the caves or return to the wilderness?
en.hap.stay-as-long-as-you-like: “Thank you again for all you've done. Stay as long as you'd like.”
en.hap.general-store: The party is in a small general store. The shopkeeper rushes up as they enter: “Thank you for saving our town. Anything I own is yours — for a significant discount.” What will they do?
en.hap.akabar-presses-forward: Akabar presses forward: “You filthy creatures think you can crush this town. We'll destroy you first!” The elves' expressions harden.
en.hap.patrol-kicks-dirt: “Off the street, peasant scum. Your pathetic kind make us sick.” The patrol kicks dirt on the party's shoes and moves on.
en.hap.move-on-to-the-inn: “Please move on to the inn. You put us in grave danger.” The peasants then flee.
en.hap.akabar-alone: “I understand. I will do my best on my own.”
en.hap.thank-you-for-bravery: “Thank you for your bravery. Stay as long as you want. We'll get you the best we have.”
en.hap.temple-of-sune: A priest approaches: “We will hide you here, in the temple of Sune, but we can do no more while the horde is about. We are too weak in this town.”
en.hap.come-in-and-rest: “Please come in and rest yourselves. We shall heal you if you wish.”
en.lava-tube.entry: You enter an ancient lava tube. Ash covers the floor.
en.lava-tube.ambush: A wave of heat bursts from hidden alcoves, followed by salamanders and dark elves.
en.lava-tube.guarded-door: The door is guarded by a salamander-led patrol.
en.lava-tube.dream-warning: A dream-like voice warns you that great danger lies ahead and that you should be fully prepared.
en.lava-tube.salamander-pools: The room is filled with active geysers and lava pits. Salamanders sport in the pools.
en.lava-tube.intense-heat: Intense heat washes over the party.
en.lava-tube.sly-parlay: The salamanders claim no love for dark elves and invite you to take any treasure you want.
en.lava-tube.nice-parlay: The salamanders tell you cold creatures to leave before Crimdrac finds you.
en.lava-tube.fireproof-casks: Among the lava pools stand six fireproof casks. Will someone try to open one?
en.lava-tube.cask-heat-retreat: The heat is too intense and the volunteer retreats. Does anyone want to try again?
en.lava-tube.silk-introduction: “You may call me Silk. I have been waiting for a group such as yours. Step forward and receive our mark.”
en.area5.depart-akabar: Akabar says your help was invaluable, wishes you well, and leaves the party to attend to other business.
en.area5.depart-akabar-reluctant: Akabar frowns and says he is sure you have your reasons to leave, but he must free this town from the wizard's tyranny. He stamps off.
en.area5.dark-elf-gear-decays: In sunlight, the dark-elven weapons and armor you carry decay to uselessness.
en.post-wizard.dracolich: A skeletal figure emerges from a copse. You recognize the voice as it vows revenge for the tutor you deprived it of.
en.essembra.edge: You are at the edge of Essembra. Will you enter the city or continue your journey?
en.essembra.places: You are in Essembra. What place will you visit?
en.essembra.outdoor-bar: You are in an outdoor bar overlooking the woods. What will you do?
en.hillsfar.fire-knives-ambush: You are ambushed by Fire Knives disguised as fighters.
en.hillsfar.edge: You are at the edge of Hillsfar. Will you enter the city or continue your journey?
en.hillsfar.places: You are in Hillsfar. What place will you visit?
en.hillsfar.dockside-bar: You are in a dockside bar. What will you do?
en.hillsfar.red-plumes-spill-drinks: Some Red Plumes deliberately spill your drinks and order you to clean up the mess. Will you comply?
en.hillsfar.bridled-storm-welcome: “Welcome, adventurers, to the Bridled Storm.” Noting the sigils, he continues: “For Zhentarim gentry I will prepare our best rooms.”
en.hillsfar.captain-impressed: The captain is impressed with the party's skill and invites them to sail with him any time.
en.hillsfar.pirates-flee: A pirate craft approaches until the party is spotted; then they pile on the canvas and flee.
en.hillsfar.abandoned-outpost: Along the coast the party passes an abandoned Zhentarim outpost and the remains of a buccaneer's base.
en.hillsfar.boat-forced-ashore: As the party's boat travels along the river, another craft comes alongside and forces them ashore.
en.yulash.red-plume-patrol: A Red Plume patrol approaches. One guard claims your tattoos reveal you as Zhentil spies.
en.yulash.edge: You are at the edge of Yulash. Will you enter the war zone or continue your journey?
en.yulash.entry: Smoke rises behind Yulash's ruined walls and battle sounds from within. How will you enter?
en.yulash.riders-burst-out: Before you enter, a man on a large horse bursts from Yulash and knocks a party member down. A woman in purple clings behind him and calls an apology as they race away.
en.yulash.checkpoint-halt: A wary guard emerges from a checkpoint as more Red Plumes gather behind him. What will you do?
en.yulash.see-commander: The guards insist that you come with them to see the commander. What will you do?
en.yulash.waiting-room: This is the commander's waiting room. The guards order you to remain until called.
en.yulash.zhentarim-spies: Troops burst from the commander's office as someone shouts that they are spies for Zhentil Keep. What will you do?
en.yulash.led-to-commander: You are led in to see the Red Plume commander.
en.yulash.looters-tell: The looters tell what they know about the city. The party records it as Journal Entry 34.
en.yulash.commander-business: The commander demands to know your business in Yulash. How will you respond?
en.yulash.commander-side-door: The commander shows you out through the side door.
en.yulash.pit-entrance: Before you lies the pit created during Moander's last appearance. Step forward to enter the dark demesne.
en.yulash.red-plume-salute: A band of Red Plume guards salutes the party and passes by.
en.yulash.red-plume-avenge-commander: Red Plume guards rush at the party yelling, “That's them! They're the scum who killed the commander!”
en.yulash.shambling-mounds: Shambling mounds rise from the debris around the party.
en.yulash.zhentil-marauders: A band of Zhentil Keep marauders jumps the party.
en.yulash.captured-cell: The party wakes in a rather dreary room. The rats eye them expectantly.
en.yulash.checkpoint-passed: The party passes the checkpoint, then comes upon a destroyed one: the mark of Zhentil Keep is smeared in blood on a wall.
en.yulash.swanmay-approved: “I see you have one of the Swanmays with you. That is good.”
en.yulash.commander-office-map: The party ransacks the commander's office and finds a map, recording the find as Journal Entry 52.
en.yulash.dead-cleric-bone-wand: The dead cleric clutches a bone wand.
en.yulash.people-let-go: The people cringe in fear, crying out for help. These are just people trying to eke out some sort of existence, and the party lets them go.
en.yulash.red-guards-mess-hall: This is the Red Plumes' mess hall.
en.yulash.mess-hall-fee: Staying costs one platinum piece. Will the party pay?
en.yulash.barracks-rest: This is the barracks. The room is about half full of resting men, who point out a spot where the party can rest.
en.yulash.unconquered-part: The party has found an unconquered part of the city.
en.yulash.about-to-leave: The party is about to leave. Do they want to?
en.yulash.green-robed-bodies: The party comes upon a large pile of green-robed bodies. Strangely, the flesh seems to change to plant life before their eyes — and the bodies are not dead. A moaned chant rises: “Moander… Moander.”
en.yulash.plant-life-frenzy: Suddenly the plant life whips about in a frenzy and forms into hideous shapes that reach for the party.
en.yulash.cultists-call-a-piece: A large number of cultists are gathered together. One intones: “Our brothers and sisters have shown us the way. We may shed our flesh and bring forth the beautiful green. Now let us call in a piece of our god.”
en.yulash.cultists-form-one-thing: The cultists gather together and shrivel into a heap. Once again flesh begins to change and flow — this time only one plant thing is forming, but it is very large.
en.yulash.zhentrim-contingent: The party comes upon a contingent of Zhentarim troops, muttering about Red Plumes and how hard they are to find.
en.yulash.red-plumes-watching-cultists: Some Red Plumes are keeping an eye on some green-robed cultists.
en.yulash.zhentrim-scum: “Begone, Zhentarim scum. You'll not soil my establishment.”
en.yulash.why-let-them-go: “Why'd you let them go? Cowardly lot, aren't you? Come with me.”
en.yulash.guard-looks-up: “Who's that?” A Red Plume guard looks up from the checkpoint. What will the party do?
en.yulash.passed-the-checkpoint: The party has passed the checkpoint.
en.yulash.destroyed-checkpoint: The party comes upon a destroyed checkpoint. The mark of Zhentil Keep is smeared in blood on a wall.
en.yulash.guards-wave-through: The guards wave the party through.
en.yulash.trying-to-sneak-past: “So, trying to sneak past us, huh?”
en.yulash.obviously-looters: “You are obviously looters. My forces shall deal with you accordingly.”
en.yulash.looters-are-fire-knives: The looters pull very wicked-looking knives from beneath their rags; the symbol of the Fire Knives is emblazoned on their leather armour.
en.yulash.sinkhole-avoided: Someone notices a possible sinkhole in the path and leads the party around it.
en.yulash.ground-collapses: The ground suddenly collapses beneath the party! They fall into a pit formed from the debris of the ruined city.
en.yulash.weak-walls-avoided: Someone notices that the walls are very weak in this area and leads the party safely past.
en.yulash.wall-crumbles: A wall suddenly crumbles and falls on top of the party!
en.yulash.checkpoint-to-the-east: The party sees a checkpoint manned by Red Plume guards to the east. What will they do?
en.yulash.war-blasted-section: The party finds a war-blasted section of the city.
en.yulash.false-door: The party has found a false door.
en.yulash.path-out: The party locates a path out. Do they want to leave?
en.yulash.graffiti-mogion: Graffiti is crudely scrawled here: “Mogion is not Moander's chosen one. We shall call down his glory.”
en.yulash.red-plume-phlan-plot: The party overhears a party of Red Plumes planning to loose a pack of Moander cultists on Phlan and then blame it on the Zhentarim, so that Phlan will ally against Zhentil Keep. What will the party do?
en.yulash.purse-lighter: After they leave, one of the party notices that his purse is considerably lighter.
en.pit.opening-dead-cultists: Three cultists lie dead on the floor. Just ahead, another cleric gasps for breath.
en.pit.opening-chosen: The wounded cleric's eyes widen with fanatical triumph and he howls, 'The chosen ones!'
en.pit.trapped: The cleric slams his fist against a protruding rock. The ceiling collapses behind you, trapping the party in the Pit of Moander.
en.pit.cleric-dies: The cleric gives you one last triumphant glare, coughs blood, and dies at your feet.
en.pit.ambience: You hear battle in the distance, while the smell of baked bread drifts through the air.
en.pit.alias-dragonbait-meet: You see a female fighter and a strange-looking lizard man; strong scents of violets, brimstone, and honeysuckle follow one another.
en.pit.alias-bonded-reaction: The female fighter gasps that you are bonded too. What will you do?
en.pit.alias-dragonbait-introduction: The fighter introduces herself as Alias and her companion as Dragonbait. She once bore tattoos like yours and asks you to tell your story.
en.pit.alias-dragonbait-join: Will you let Alias and Dragonbait join the party?
en.pit.alias-dragonbait-joined: Alias and Dragonbait join the party. Alias adds that the treasure Mogion keeps behind her altar is also worth handling.
en.pit.stairs-down: Stairs lead down toward the south. Will you descend?
en.pit.stairs-up: Stairs in the north wall lead upward. Will you ascend?
en.pit.dead-zhentrim: You find the mangled remains of a dead Zhentrim fighter. What will you do?
en.pit.zhentrim-scroll: A formal document bearing Zhentil Keep's seal is clenched in the fighter's fist. You copy it as Journal Entry 46.
en.pit.mogion-altar: A priestess turns and smiles wickedly before an altar while cultists chant in a low drone.
en.pit.alias-identifies-mogion: Alias mutters that this is Moander's high priestess. The priestess turns and spits on the ground.
en.pit.mogion-greeting: Mogion welcomes you and remarks that nothing can be accomplished without the proper tools. What will you do?
en.pit.bond-paralysis: Before you can act, the bonds on your arms flash blue and surround the party. You cannot move.
en.pit.alias-dragonbait-tendrils: Tendrils rise from the floor and bind Alias and Dragonbait.
en.pit.mogion-ritual: Mogion turns toward the altar as the chanting rises.
en.pit.dimensional-window: The blue light surrounding you flows to Mogion. Power drawn from the bonds opens a dimensional window above the altar.
en.pit.moander-returns: Mogion shrieks that Moander returns as a mass of slime, mold, and corruption begins to ooze through the dimensional rift.
en.pit.bond-fades: Energy in the rift increases. Moander's bond burns and begins to fade as the opening grows.
en.pit.bond-broken: Moander's sigil disappears, and the paralysis gripping the party is gone.
en.pit.alias-attack-mogion: Alias and Dragonbait hack free of the tendrils. Alias urges you to attack unless you wish to fight a god. What will you do?
en.pit.remnants-scream: Three pseudopods of Moander that crossed the rift sprout hundreds of mouths and scream, 'You have killed me!'
en.pit.remnants-attack: The oozing mounds turn and attack you.
en.pit.gauntlet: You find the Gauntlet of Moander among the slimy remains.
en.pit.priest-flees: A priest bursts into the room, sees the aftermath, and flees into the corridor shouting, 'They have killed the god!'
en.pit.altar-treasure: You find a cache of jewels and gems in the altar.
en.pit.exit-last-stand: A large force of Moander's cultists attacks in a last-ditch effort to stop your escape.
en.ashabenford.tilvers-gap: Mountains rise into an impassable wall broken only by Tilver's Gap. Flying shapes circle down from the snowy peaks.
en.ashabenford.edge: You are at the edge of Ashabenford. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.ashabenford.places: You are in Ashabenford. What place will you visit?
en.ashabenford.ale-house: You are in a riverside ale house. What will you do?
en.ashabenford.tavern-tale-28: You overhear Tavern Tale 28: two ships bound for Shadowdale have disappeared, and the river has become very dangerous.
en.ashabenford.barn-for-zhentil: “Don't think much of Zhentil Keepers. The barn's the best you'll get.”
en.ashabenford.tavern-turns-friendly: The patrons become surly and the bartender suggests the party leave — then a farmer stands up and tells them of the party's defeat of the ettins. They quiet down and become friendly.
en.shadow-gap.fire-knives-patrol: Fire Knives disguised as a patrol ambush you.
en.shadow-gap.new-inn: The party reaches Shadow Gap. Atop it stands a recently built inn — a perfect place to rest.
en.standing-stone.grey-man: You are at the Standing Stones. A grey-robed man sits against one of the stones, his face hidden in shadow.
en.standing-stone.four-masters: The grey-robed man says you presently serve four masters. Return after slaying three more, and you will fulfill your destiny. What will you do?
en.standing-stone.two-masters: The grey-robed man says you presently serve two masters. Return after slaying one more, and you will fulfill your destiny. What will you do?
en.standing-stone.seek-red: He continues, 'Seek red to the south.'
en.standing-stone.edge: The party is at the edge of the Standing Stones. Will they enter or continue their journey?
en.world-route.essembra: How will you get to Essembra?
en.world-route.hap: How will you get to Hap?
en.world-route.tilverton: How will the party get to Tilverton?
en.world-route.shadowdale: How will the party get to Shadowdale?
en.world-route.ashabenford: How will the party get to Ashabenford?
en.world-route.dagger-falls: How will the party get to Dagger Falls?
en.world-route.standing-stone: How will the party get to the Standing Stones?
en.world-route.voonlar: How will the party get to Voonlar?
en.world-route.teshwave: How will the party get to Teshwave?
en.world-route.hillsfar: How will the party get to Hillsfar?
en.world-route.myth-drannor: How will the party get to Myth Drannor?
en.world-route.phlan: How will the party get to Phlan?
en.world-route.yulash: How will the party get to Yulash?
en.world-route.zhentil: How will the party get to Zhentil Keep?
en.tilverton.guildmaster-greeting: A burly man stands before you, surrounded by wary guards. He nervously asks whether you care to rest.
en.tilverton.running-thieves: You come upon some running thieves. What do you do?
en.tilverton.running-thieves-warning: They yell, as they run past, 'The Fire Knives are pushing up from the south. They are boiling out of the sewers.'
en.tilverton.fire-knives-spot-you: A party of Fire Knives spots you.
en.tilverton.guild-metal-and-animals: The clang of metal on metal and the growls of animals locked in mortal combat echo through the halls.
en.tilverton.guild-bodies-after-battle: Bodies lie twisted one about another, locked in combat until death.
en.tilverton.guildmaster-briefing: The guildmaster explains that the Fire Knives hold the king's daughter in their hideout as bait, and offers information because he cannot act directly.
en.tilverton.guild-breach: A side door explodes inward with a deafening crash.
en.tilverton.guild-fire-knife-command: A Fire Knife shouts, 'Traitorous scum! Seize them all!' as thieves spread out around you.
en.tilverton.guild-poisoned-dagger: The guildmaster hurls a poisoned dagger into a Fire Knife's throat; the victim collapses, twitching violently.
en.tilverton.guild-battle-joined: An arrow strikes the guildmaster in the chest as four loyal thieves join your side and the battle begins.
en.tilverton.guild-halfling: Down the corridor, a halfling carrying a harp slips through a doorway and disappears.
en.tilverton.guild-kennel-intro: Hungry snarls greet you as a Fire Knife releases the pack.
en.tilverton.guild-kennel-aftermath: Gnawed bones and broken leashes litter the room.
en.tilverton.guild-monkey-cages: You see empty cages that once held monkeys.
en.tilverton.guild-guest-book: An open guest book ends with: 'Olive Ruskettle, Bard of the Realms—touch the harp at your peril.'
en.tilverton.guild-sewer-traces: Green slimy marks on the floor become more distinct near the door.
en.tilverton.sewers-entry: You enter Tilverton's foul-smelling, slime-covered sewers. The slick floor and low ceiling will make fighting awkward.
en.tilverton.sewers.guild-battle-echoes: You still hear the occasional sounds of battle echoing from the guild hall.
en.fire-knife.hideout-entry: You are entering the Fire Knife hideout.
en.fire-knife.blade-barrier: A cloud of whirling blades fills the doorway, its metallic whine drowning out nearly every other sound. What will you do?
en.fire-knife.blade-barrier-damage: The whirling blades tear into you.
en.fire-knife.blade-barrier-fades: The blades slow and fade away; their whine falls to a whisper and then silence. Others seem to have been caught here before you.
en.fire-knife.frozen-room: People are frozen in fighting poses; some lie twisted together while others are beginning to move. What will you do?
en.fire-knife.frozen-kill: You slaughter them before they recover from being held.
en.fire-knife.office: This ornate room appears to be the office of someone high in the Fire Knives.
en.fire-knife.wounded-mutterings: The rest of the wounded are harmless. Passing through, the party overhears mutterings and records them as Journal Entry 27.
en.fire-knife.smoky-hall: As you enter the corridor, you notice a strange smoky scent.
en.fire-knife.ordered-bedroom: The bedroom is extremely well ordered. You find nothing valuable; as you leave, unseen servants begin restoring everything to its exact place.
en.fire-knife.burned-library: This room was once a library, but its shelves and books are now smoking ash. A charred body at the center clutches a sheet of paper.
en.fire-knife.burned-lab: This room was once a laboratory. Fierce flames swept through it, and nothing escaped destruction.
en.fire-knife.shrouded-bodies: Two rows of shrouded bodies lie here. Signs mark one row 'to be raised' and the other 'to be buried.'
en.fire-knife.taken-to-leader: The party is being taken to their leader.
en.fire-knife.hospital-room: The room has been converted to a hospital. Wounded Fire Knives lie moaning in the beds; those that can rush out through the west wall.
en.fire-knife.storage-room: The room seems to be used as a storage area.
en.fire-knife.torture-tables: Poking around, the party finds tables fitted with straps and a set of intricate tools; the tip of one has a bluish hue matching the sigils. The next room is dark and smoky, hung with every form of torture implement. On a rack in the middle lies a well-muscled, middle-aged man, with Fire Knives working the equipment around him.
en.fire-knife.assassins-engrossed: The assassins are engrossed in their task and seem unaware of the party. What will they do?
en.fire-knife.checkpoint-remains: The party sees the remains of a Fire Knife checkpoint. Only Fire Knives are among the bodies.
en.fire-knife.checkpoint-abandoned: There are signs that this is normally a checkpoint, but it has been hurriedly abandoned.
en.fire-knife.secret-door-found: The party found a secret door.
en.fire-knife.armory-metal-box: The party finds the armoury, and a large metal box. Do they open it?
en.fire-knife.rescue-nacacia: The party releases the man from the rack and he collapses to the floor, badly used by the Fire Knives. He whispers: “Don't worry about me. Rescue Nacacia — she's in here somewhere.”
en.fire-knife.refuses-assistance: He refuses all offers of assistance, insisting the party save their energy for the rescue. All he will accept is his hammer, which was leaning against the rack, and he insists they go on without him.
en.fire-knife.hideout-quiet: The hideout is strangely quiet for such a normally active place.
en.fire-knife.kybor-incinerated: From somewhere nearby comes a panicked voice: “I went to get Kybor, to interrogate the prisoner. His whole place was incinerated. This place must be cursed.”
en.fire-knife.azoun-effigy: Against the wall stands a stuffed figure of King Azoun, showing the marks of innumerable knife tosses.
en.fire-knife.kill-vangerdahast: An angry voice echoes through the silent corridors: “Kybor's dead?! Well, you were supposed to guard him, so you get the honour of killing Vangerdahast instead.”
en.fire-knife.program-them-for-voice: The eerie silence carries another voice: “That fop couldn't fool anyone on sight. Next time we should program them for something other than voice.”
en.fire-knife.patrol-charges: The party is spotted by a Fire Knife patrol, who charge immediately.
en.fire-knife.torture-chamber: This dark and smoky room is hung with every form of torture implement. On a rack in the middle lies a well-muscled, middle-aged man, with Fire Knives working the equipment around him.
en.fire-knife.checkpoint-north: The party spots a checkpoint to the north.
en.fire-knife.checkpoint-east: The party spots a checkpoint to the east.
en.fire-knife.checkpoint-south: The party spots a checkpoint to the south.
en.fire-knife.checkpoint-west: The party spots a checkpoint to the west.
en.tilverton.carriage-gate-closed: Royal guards tell you this way is closed because the royal carriage is coming soon, and send you back into the city.
en.tilverton.green-robes-rumor: As you pass through the crowds, you hear, 'The woman in the green robes—eyes of a fanatic.'
en.tilverton.carriage-make-way: Royal guards shout, 'Make way for the royal carriage!'
en.tilverton.carriage-bond-compulsion: The king's voice comes from the carriage. Your azure bonds flare, and an irresistible compulsion forces you to attack.
en.tilverton.carriage-false-king: As the carriage withdraws, a young man cries that he is not really the king. Seeing your azure markings, he gasps, 'Oh no! Not again!' and faints as the glow fades.
en.tilverton.carriage-alarm: A loud bell rings behind you as royal guards charge with swords drawn.
en.tilverton.carriage-abduction: Two red-robed men leap onto the carriage, drag the frail young man out, and haul him into an alleyway.
en.tilverton.carriage-thief-rescue: Hours later, one wall slides open and a thief appears. He returns your equipment and signals you to follow him.
en.tilverton.carriage-guild-arrival: The thief leads you through hidden passages to a dark underground area: the thieves' guild of Tilverton.
en.tilverton.sewers-checkpoint: Fire Knives demand your immediate surrender. Do you surrender?
en.tilverton.sewers-hide-bodies: You quickly hide the Fire Knives' bodies.
en.tilverton.sewers.paper-scrap: A scrap of paper pokes above the muck. The party copies it as Journal Entry 41.
en.tilverton.sewers-knight-appears: The slaughtered remains of a Fire Knife checkpoint lie here. A swordsman wearing the uniform of the Knights of Myth Drannor steps from the shadows.
en.tilverton.sewers-knight-allegiance: The knight notes your Fire Knife markings and asks to whom you owe allegiance, knowing the cursed Flamed One may control people through such brands.
en.tilverton.sewers-knight-princess-friend: He laughs that the princess is popular, tells you to continue south, and warns you not to kill the cleric with a hammer who is also trying to rescue her.
en.tilverton.high-priest-intro: The high priest says, 'You look troubled, my children. Do you wish to tell me your story?'
en.tilverton.edge: You are at the edge of Tilverton. Will you enter the city or continue your journey?
en.tilverton.entry-barred: Guards bar your way and refuse to let you re-enter Tilverton.
en.tilverton.door-locked-guards: The door is locked, and the attempt to open it has attracted a group of royal guards.
en.tilverton.patrol-attacks: A patrol arrives. Someone shouts, “There they are!”
en.tilverton.patrol-move-along: A patrol arrives and the royal guards tell the party to move along.
en.tilverton.reinforcements-flee: Reinforcements are coming, so the party moves away.
en.tilverton.narrow-street: The street grows narrow and dim here, with trash piled in the corners.
en.tilverton.patrol-surrender-demand: A patrol spots the party and one guard asks them to surrender. Will they?
en.tilverton.rumor.sewer-scream: Passing through the crowds you overhear: “I swear I heard a woman screaming in the sewers.”
en.tilverton.rumor.dragon-flight: Passing through the crowds you overhear: “I'm certain it was a dragon that passed over last night. Gond help us if there's another flight of the dragons.”
en.tilverton.rumor.troops: Passing through the crowds you overhear: “The town was safer before the troops came. Now strange folk are about.”
en.tilverton.rumor.gharri-sighted: Passing through the crowds you overhear: “Someone said that Gharri was seen just outside of town.”
en.tilverton.rumor.knives-bolder: Passing through the crowds you overhear: “The Fire Knives are getting bolder. Something's gonna blow.”
en.tilverton.alley.man-calls: A man yells from a nearby alleyway: “Over here, before the guards finish you off!”
en.tilverton.alley.safer: The dark alleyways look safer than the main streets.
en.tilverton.alley.not-searched: The guards do not appear to be searching the alleys.
en.tilverton.alley.escape-route: A man waves from an alleyway; it looks like an avenue of escape.
en.tilverton.sewers.sealed-exit: The way is blocked by a placard: “Sealed by order of His Majesty King Azoun IV.” Will the party exit to the wilderness?
en.tilverton.smithy.farewell-and-pitch: “Thank you. Return soon.” “We have a selection of the finest Cormyr steel. Interested?”
en.tilverton.smithy.strike-true: “May you always strike true.” “Good day then.”
en.tilverton.inn.innkeeper-welcome: “Welcome to the fair city of Tilverton,” beams the innkeeper — then she notices the party's collective scowls.
en.tilverton.inn.nightmare-man: On the bed lies a dishevelled man thrashing in the grip of some great nightmare. He screams: “Flaming giant … blood red mage … the glinting knife … plants that walk … aieghhh!”
en.tilverton.inn.nightmare-man-taken-away: His voice drops to incoherent mumbling. The innkeeper rushes up: “Please leave the man alone. He was found in this state just before you arrived, lying near the sewer outfall. Poor man.” The party leaves, and notes that the bartender has a black eye and his arm in a sling.
en.tilverton.filani.side-door: “Sorry, but this is the side door — enter through the front.” “I am the sage Filani. You are here about the sigils, correct?”
en.tilverton.filani.half-your-funds: “This is an interesting case. I'll do it for half your funds. How much do you have?”
en.tilverton.training-hall.nothing-to-discu: “Then we have nothing to discuss.” “Do you want to train?”
