en.tilverton.training-hall.great-progress: “You're showing great progress. Return again when you are ready.” The party leaves the hall.
en.tilverton.temple.service-begins: As the party wanders the temple, people begin to stream in. A priest stands before the altar and begins a service, and the party turns to listen.
en.tilverton.temple.sermon-theme: The sermon's theme is everything's place in the world — especially Tilverton's and the Cormyr defence force's.
en.tilverton.hideout.safe-door: The door is stout enough to hold against an attack; the party could rest here safely.
en.tilverton.hideout.dogs-released: The Fire Knives release their dogs.
en.tilverton.hideout.stone-shatters: A stone shatters against the wall near the party's heads.
en.tilverton.hideout.menagerie: The party is attacked by a menagerie.
en.tilverton.hideout.growl-as-you-escape: They growl loudly as the party escapes.
en.tilverton.sewers.spoils-and-master: They collect money and equipment and head off to enjoy the spoils, laughing: “The master is at the south end of the sewers. Tell him we sent you on.” Then a sound comes from the south and west, suddenly cut off.
en.tilverton.sewers.hidden-training-hall: The party enters the hidden chambers. “Welcome to the secret training hall of the guild. Would you care to train?”
en.tilverton.sewers.purple-cloth-and-otyugh: “Just search around this area to find us again.” A scrap of purple cloth clings to the bottom of the south door hinge. Burnt into the wall is the symbol of a hand with a mouth for a palm, and the faint stench of decayed flesh hangs here. In the next room the stench turns terrible, and out of a particularly nasty pile comes a pack of otyugh.
en.tilverton.sewers.otyugh-toll: “Where are the treasures you have promised us? You may not pass through this room without the food.”
en.tilverton.sewers.otyugh-payment-accepted: The otyugh bounce about in apparent joy at the gifts. They pluck an object from the fetid pyramid and toss it to the party, then relieve them of their unpleasant baggage of trash. “You may pass through freely.”
en.tilverton.sewers.zhentrim-jewelry: The object is a glittering piece of jewellery, ornately sculpted in the symbol of the Zhentarim. It looks to have been worn until recently. A few other trinkets come with it.
en.tilverton.sewers.otyugh-friends: “Pass through freely, you are friends.” The next room is filled with filth, most of the smell coming from two piles near the centre; the otyugh there attack immediately.
en.tilverton.sewers.carry-the-piles: It is obvious which piles the other otyugh wanted; unpleasant as it is, the party could carry them back. Will they? Beyond, the room is swampy and the party sinks to the knees. Trolls sit on a small tussock tossing hunks of meat to wallowing crocodiles, and turn to the party: “Another pile of meat, and so soon.”
en.tilverton.sewers.bonegrinder-ambush: As the door opens, hands reach down from above and a deep bass voice says: “Wait, you're not Bonegrinder — but you'll probably taste better.”
en.tilverton.sewers.safe-place-to-rest: With the monsters defeated, this looks like a safe place to rest.
en.tilverton.sewers.something-on-the-ceilin: Something is flapping on the ceiling. To tell what it is, someone will have to climb up — only a thief could succeed. Does anyone want to?
en.tilverton.sewers.assassins-find-camp: A band of assassins has located the party's camp.
en.tilverton.sewers.otyugh-mistake-food: Some otyugh mistake the party for food.
en.tilverton.sewers.trolls-walking-crocodil: Some trolls are out walking their crocodiles.
en.tilverton.sewers.large-shapes-corridor: Very large shapes come down the corridor.
en.tilverton.royal-guards-move-along: Royal guards tell the party to move along.
en.tilverton.shop.good-day-purchase: “Good day to you, gentle persons. Do you wish to make a purchase?”
en.tilverton.shop.return-soon: “Thank you. Return soon.” The party moves away.
en.tilverton.smithy.cormyr-steel: “We have a selection of the finest Cormyr steel. Interested?”
en.tilverton.smithy.strike-true-farewell: “May you always strike true.” The party moves away.
en.tilverton.shop.good-day-then: “Good day then.” The party moves away.
en.tilverton.inn.man-left-alone: His voice drops to incoherent mumbling. The innkeeper rushes up: “Please leave the man alone. He was found in this state just before you arrived, lying near the sewer outfall. Poor man.” The party leaves.
en.tilverton.tavern.bartender-black-eye: The bartender has a black eye and his arm in a sling.
en.tilverton.tavern.bartender-excuse: He looks at the blue sigils and blanches, then stammers: “J-just tripped over the bar while cleaning the place. These things happen.” He gives a forced laugh.
en.tilverton.tavern.peppery-drink: He hands over a glass of clear liquid with a few small seeds floating in it. It has a peppery smell.
en.tilverton.tavern.spray-the-patron: The fieriness of the drink is too much, and it sprays all over a fellow patron — who, in turn, smiles.
en.tilverton.tavern.steaming-glass: He brings out a steaming glass that smells strongly of alcohol and of something unidentifiable.
en.tilverton.tavern.unable-to-move: For a few moments after drinking it the party cannot move, though the effect is not unpleasant.
en.tilverton.tavern.brown-liquid: He hands over a mug of opaque brown liquid.
en.tilverton.tavern.brawl: The party gets into a brawl.
en.tilverton.tavern.special-customer: “A special customer's arrived. You have to slip outside for a moment.” Does the party go?
en.tilverton.tavern.time-to-move-on: “Drink up, gentlemen. It's time for you to move on.” Does the party go?
en.tilverton.tavern.purple-sash-slips-in: As the party walks out the door, a young woman with a purple sash slips in the side door. A few of the other patrons hang back, as if to meet her.
en.tilverton.tavern.commotion-outside: As the party considers its next move, a commotion breaks out around the side of the building. Do they investigate?
en.tilverton.tavern.party-passes-out: After much roistering the party passes out.
en.tilverton.tavern.wake-at-inn: The party wakes in their beds at the inn. The innkeeper pokes his head in: “You're lucky the bartender's a good man. He dropped you off here to sleep it off.”
en.tilverton.filani.side-door-only: “Sorry, but this is the side door. Enter through the front door.” The party moves away.
en.tilverton.filani.introduces: “I am the sage Filani. You are here about the sigils, correct?”
en.tilverton.filani.sages-are-not-fools: “Do not think sages are fools.” She sends the party out.
en.tilverton.filani.nothing-to-discuss: “Then we have nothing to discuss.” The party moves away.
en.tilverton.temple.acolyte-greeting: An acolyte greets the party: “If you want healing, pray at the altar. The high priest's residence is in the south.” He bows and walks away.
en.tilverton.temple.go-with-gond: “Go with Gond.” The party moves away.
en.tilverton.temple.occupation-force: Nearby someone comments, “Defence, hah — should be occupation force.” The service winds down and people file out.
en.tilverton.alley.psst-commere: “Psst. C'mere,” comes a whisper from down the alley.
en.tilverton.thief-offers-escape: A thief appears and offers to lead the party to safety. Do they accept?
en.tilverton.hideout.treasure-room: The party has found the treasure room.
en.tilverton.hideout.thieves-leap: The thieves leap into the fray.
en.tilverton.hideout.wounded-dogs: Wounded dogs back away, growling; their masters lie dead on the floor.
en.tilverton.hideout.green-robed-woman: A young woman in a green robe lies in a pool of blood. Near her is a broken staff surmounted by a hand with a mouth for a palm, and a piece of paper.
en.tilverton.hideout.watch-the-chosen-ones: The paper reads: “Keep watch on the chosen ones.”
en.tilverton.sewers.honorable-man: “I am in charge of holding this corridor against your kind. You may flee or surrender. I'm an honourable man.” What will the party do?
en.tilverton.sewers.gharri-is-late: He accepts the surrender and the party waits. After an hour of amiable conversation he mutters, “Gharri's late — knew his rescue plan was stupid,” then says: “Go on ahead. You might be a distraction.”
en.tilverton.sewers.dont-kill-the-cleric: “For a small city's sewer, this place teems with activity. If you're heading for the hideout, don't kill the cleric with the hammer — he's with me.” He lets the party pass.
en.tilverton.sewers.sound-cut-off: A sound comes from the south and west, suddenly cut off.
en.tilverton.sewers.otyugh-pyramids: Piles of excrement have been shaped into pyramids here, and many otyugh are smoothing the sides and adding artistic embellishments. A glint of metal comes from one pile. What will the party do?
en.tilverton.sewers.telepathic-bargain: A telepathic buzz fills the party's minds: “If you wish the shiny thing, then we must have treasure in return. To the south are others of our ilk, who have two fine-smelling piles of food. Bring us those.”
en.tilverton.sewers.walls-too-slimy: The walls prove too slimy and the climber falls. Does anyone want to try again?
en.tilverton.sewers.swatch-of-cloth: The thief retrieves a swatch of cloth from a sealed trapdoor; the door is too well jammed to open. The scent of a tavern wafts down through it. The cloth matches the dress worn by the woman who disappeared from the bar.
en.tilverton.sewers.tattered-green-robe: A tattered green robe lies trampled in the muck.
en.tilverton.sewers.shuffling-feet: The party hears the shuffling of large feet but cannot place the direction because of the echoes.
en.tilverton.sewers.two-red-robed-assassins: Stuffed into a crevice are the slain bodies of two red-robed assassins. It would take something powerful to have lodged them so tightly.
en.tilverton.sewers.defective-sigils: The remains of a body lie here. One arm is marked with defective versions of the sigils on the party's arms.
en.tilverton.sewers.giant-rats-flee: Rats the size of large dogs rush away at the party's approach.
en.tilverton.sewers.troll-pieces: Pieces of trolls lie strewn about here. What will the party do?
en.tilverton.sewers.pieces-coalesce: The pieces eventually coalesce into three trolls.
en.tilverton.sewers.sear-the-pieces: The party quickly sears the pieces into inactivity.
en.tilverton.sewers.guild-training-offer: “Welcome to the secret training hall of the guild. Would you care to train?”
en.tilverton.sewers.purple-cloth: A scrap of purple cloth clings to the bottom of the south door hinge.
en.tilverton.sewers.hand-with-mouth: Burnt into the wall is the symbol of a hand with a mouth for a palm; the faint stench of decayed flesh hangs here.
en.tilverton.sewers.pack-of-otyugh: A terrible stench assaults the party as they enter this room; out of a particularly nasty pile comes a pack of otyugh.
en.tilverton.sewers.two-piles-attack: The room is filled with filth, though most of the smell comes from two piles near the centre. The otyugh attack immediately.
en.tilverton.sewers.trolls-and-crocodiles: The room is swampy and the party sinks to the knees. Trolls sit on a small tussock tossing hunks of meat to wallowing crocodiles, and turn to the party: “Another pile of meat, and so soon.”
en.tilverton.sign.general-store: A sign hangs overhead: Tilverton General Store.
en.tilverton.sign.weaponers: A sign hangs overhead: Weaponers of Cormyr.
en.tilverton.sign.windlords-inn: A sign hangs overhead: Windlord's Inn.
en.tilverton.sign.the-curse: A sign hangs overhead: The Curse.
en.tilverton.sign.sage-filani: A sign hangs overhead: The Sage Filani.
en.tilverton.sign.hall-of-training: A sign hangs overhead: The Hall of Training.
en.tilverton.sign.temple-of-gond: A sign hangs overhead: Temple of Gond.
en.tilverton.sewers.checkpoint-remains-nort: The party spots the remains of a checkpoint to the north.
en.tilverton.sewers.checkpoint-remains-east: The party spots the remains of a checkpoint to the east.
en.tilverton.sewers.checkpoint-remains-sout: The party spots the remains of a checkpoint to the south.
en.tilverton.sewers.checkpoint-remains-west: The party spots the remains of a checkpoint to the west.
en.bond-dream.first-night: On the first night outside the city, a strange weariness overcomes the whole party. Even the watch falls asleep, and without warning you enter a vivid dream.
en.bond-dream.masters-taunt: Four faces leer down at your victory. An ominous voice declares that the first and weakest of your masters has fallen, and your path of servitude has begun.
en.bond-dream.masters-prophecy: You will serve them in turn despite your will: the wizard in red, the woman in green, and the lord of darkness—until you become pawns of the Flamed One.
en.bond-dream.ends: The four faces laugh with evil joy. The dream fades, and you awake in a cold sweat.
en.essembra.tavern-tale-60: You overhear Tavern Tale 60: several huge shapes were seen flying over the forest toward the south.
en.essembra.tavern-tale-44: You overhear Tavern Tale 44: the wizard in red favors creatures of flame, and cold attacks are often the best defense.
en.journal-trigger.pit-temple-map-20: You also find a map of the temple and record it as Journal Entry 20.
en.journal-trigger.alias-story-3: Alias tells her story; you record it as Journal Entry 3.
en.journal-trigger.yulash-commander-22: The commander is pleased and gives you free passage; you record Journal Entries 22 and 52.
en.journal-trigger.guildmaster-map-4: The dying guildmaster reveals a sewer map, which you record as Journal Entry 4.
en.journal-trigger.fire-knives-leader-11: The Fire Knives' leader speaks; you record his words as Journal Entry 11.
en.journal-trigger.fire-knives-victory-54: The Fire Knives have been defeated; the princess interrogates their leader in Journal Entry 54.
en.journal-trigger.fire-knives-royal-arriva: As you free Giogi, the roof vanishes; the events are recorded as Journal Entry 53.
en.journal-trigger.tilverton-inn-31: You record the innkeeper's explanation as Journal Entry 31. She suggests visiting Filani and the shop across the way.
en.journal-trigger.filani-38: Filani explains the five sigils; you record her findings as Journal Entry 38.
en.journal-trigger.tavern-knife-17: Only an ornate knife remains; you record its appearance as Journal Entry 17.
en.journal-trigger.shadowdale-warning-18: The hooded man warns you about the crescent bond; you record his advice as Journal Entry 18.
en.journal-trigger.high-priest-19: The high priest casts Remove Curse, but the bonds resist; you record the result as Journal Entry 19.
en.journal-trigger.frozen-room-26: You disarm and question the Fire Knives; their account becomes Journal Entry 26.
en.journal-trigger.fire-knives-office-9: You find revealing papers in the rosewood desk and record Journal Entry 9.
en.journal-trigger.fire-knives-paper-29: A charred hand preserved part of a paper; you record it as Journal Entry 29.
en.journal.20: Journal Entry 20: A dungeon map. A west exit leads to the wilderness, a northern corridor runs to Yulash, and stairs descend at the lower right. The key marks doors, impassable areas and stairs.
en.journal.3.1: Journal Entry 3 (1/3): Alias says she once bore similar bonds. A Master Harper tried to create an immortal vessel for his work, but an assistant died; the Harpers stripped his power and name and imprisoned him outside the world.
en.journal.3.2: Journal Entry 3 (2/3): Mages and monsters found the nameless bard and used his research to create Alias. The demon Phalse abducted the saurial paladin Dragonbait, but Dragonbait shared part of his spirit with her, and the bard sacrificed himself to help them escape.
en.journal.3.3: Journal Entry 3 (3/3): Alias awoke with false memories and bonds like yours. She won freedom by resisting each compulsion and destroying its maker. Moander's cult helped bind her, and she believes its new altar is in this temple; she and Dragonbait offer their aid.
en.journal.22.1: Journal Entry 22 (1/2): The Red Plume commander grants free passage through Yulash, but warns that the besieged city still contains Zhentil terror teams and shambling mounds.
en.journal.22.2: Journal Entry 22 (2/2): He provides a map to the Pit and the checkpoints (Journal Entry 52), marks the barracks and mess, and warns that the damaged walls and pavement may be unstable.
en.journal.52: Journal Entry 52: The Red Plumes' map of Yulash marks headquarters, checkpoints, the mess, barracks, brig, old stables, and the one-way route to the Pit of Moander.
en.journal.4: Journal Entry 4: A sewer map marked Guild and Hideout shows the narrow route from the Tilverton thieves' guild to the Fire Knives' base.
en.journal.11.1: Journal Entry 11 (1/2): The Fire Knives' leader says your arrival is well timed, but you attacked the wrong target. He points to two prisoners: a thin bearded man and a young woman wearing a torn purple sash.
en.journal.11.2: Journal Entry 11 (2/2): The man is Giogi Wyvernspur, a gifted mimic, and the woman is Princess Nacacia. She breaks free, clubs the leader, and urges you to defeat his guards before he invokes your bonds.
en.journal.54: Journal Entry 54: With a dagger at his throat, the recovering Fire Knives' leader agrees to release you. He mouths a meaningless syllable and the Fire Knives bond fades.
en.journal.53.1: Journal Entry 53 (1/2): The roof vanishes and King Azoun, Vangerdahast, and royal guards descend. A guard identifies you as the king's attackers, but Nacacia says the Fire Knives controlled you and that you saved her.
en.journal.53.2: Journal Entry 53 (2/2): The king banishes you from Cormyr because other bonds still control you. Gharri reunites with Nacacia; after the guards escort you out, the pair ride north and she waves farewell.
en.journal.31: Journal Entry 31: Red-robed people brought you to the inn nearly dead and prepaid your rooms. You already bore the tattoos. The innkeeper recommends Filani the sage, two blocks north.
en.journal.38.1: Journal Entry 38 (1/3): Filani recognizes three of the five symbols. The flame and dagger belongs to the Fire Knives, assassins once based in Westgate; their old organization was destroyed, so they must have a new base.
en.journal.38.2: Journal Entry 38 (2/3): The mouth in a palm belongs to Moander, whose brief return devastated part of Yulash. The ornate Z in a triangle represents the Zhentrim, the Black Network.
en.journal.38.3: Journal Entry 38 (3/3): The Zhentrim are an evil alliance in Zhentil Keep. Filani does not recognize the flaming symbol; the crescent resembles a powerful Shadowdale sage, and she refuses to say more.
en.journal.17: Journal Entry 17: An ornate knife remains in the alley. It has a dark handle, broad guard, and irregular flame-shaped blade—the mark of the Fire Knives.
en.journal.18: Journal Entry 18: The crescent bond resembles Elminster's symbol. Quietly leave Shadowdale, sail to Ashabenford, find the red wizard's tower to the south, and force him to remove it—or risk Elminster turning you into a newt.
en.journal.19: Journal Entry 19: Remove Curse makes the bonds blaze with blue fire and the party writhe in pain. The cleric stops; the bonds resist his power, and he cannot remove them.
en.journal.26: Journal Entry 26: An invading cleric paralyzed these men while trying to reach the prisoners in the leader's room to the south. The Fire Knives finally overcame him here.
en.journal.9: Journal Entry 9: Beside a flaming humanoid are three notes: it has a flaming aura, can possess other bodies, and is connected to the Pool of Radiance.
en.journal.29: Journal Entry 29: The surviving paper says their ally controls flame, moves from body to body, and has extra-dimensional powers. The writer concludes that the Flamed One can only be Tyran…
en.journal.21: Journal Entry 21: A letter from Myrixelets to his brother Alaterian demands three hundred gold pieces and threatens to come after him with a bastard sword. He does not care that Alaterian belongs to the Black Network — they cannot watch him all the time — and says he still has tricks to use on a slime-ridden Otyugh like his brother. Mom and Dad are fine, Sis is getting too big for her britches, and he may head down to the village of Hap to look into rumours of gathering black dragons. He asks when Alaterian is coming back to Essembra, since his wife Lilian wants to know, and adds that he would take her instead of the money.
en.journal.23: Journal Entry 23: The odds at the arena. Condemned prisoners who admitted their guilt fight monsters without weapons: three to one on the prisoners, even money on the monsters. Accused prisoners who claim innocence keep their weapons and fight to see whether Bane judges them worthy: two to one on either side. One platinum piece places a bet.
en.journal.34: Journal Entry 34: Unseen pits riddle the city and walls can collapse without warning. Red Plumes search every corner with orders to kill looters on sight. The great pit lies against the north wall in the north-east corner; Red Plume checkpoints stand before the pit and before the commander's post.
en.journal.41: Journal Entry 41: A stained note warns that the Fire Knives, the cultists and the wizards are all unreliable, and that one of them is extremely dangerous. It singles out the new alliance as untrustworthy: word about the bonded ones cannot be taken from them, and a separate watch must be set.
en.journal.44: Journal Entry 44: The current leader of the Swanmays took over after Kith and Belinda disappeared on the Great Glacier. She needs someone to infiltrate the Red Wizard's tower, and has heard that Dracandros is looking for a party bearing those symbols. He has gathered every black dragon in the area into the tower, and the Swanmays need a special piece of one of them. Accepting their mark makes the party eligible for a share of the reward; she has influence with the families guarding these caves and can get the party to the tower.
en.journal.24: Journal Entry 24: “Hail Harper's Friend, we must warn you that Dracandros of Thay seeks to use you against dragonkind. To protect yourself you should seek a deadly blade that he has secreted in the caves below his tower. Still, avoid the dragons if possible; they are quite deadly.” The letter is unsigned.
en.journal.27: Journal Entry 27: The wounded men moan in terror about a hammer-wielding maniac and a room that suddenly filled with flashing blades. They hope the leader's two prisoners are worth the trouble.
en.journal.35: Journal Entry 35: “Friend, we have come upon more news for you. To slay the accursed Flamed One who holds the most powerful of your bonds, you will need three items: the Helm of Dragons, the Gauntlet of Moander and the Amulet of Lathander. Each is held by one of those controlling your bonds. Without these he will be able to ignore your most powerful attacks.” The letter is unsigned.
en.journal.36: Journal Entry 36: “We've been here almost a month whipping these bugbears and wargs into shape. Now you've got the easy part. We can't lead these monsters against Dagger Falls ourselves; otherwise they would realize the Zhentrim were behind it. So you take the beasties to Dagger Falls and attack the city. We'll have a rescue force of Zhentil Keep troops arrive soon after and repulse your attack. Then we'll occupy the city as heroes and you'll be paid most handsomely. Well, we're off to Teshwave. Good luck.”
en.journal.42: Journal Entry 42: “Friend of the Harpers, we are working to provide you with allies. We have arranged for a rather unusual harp player to meet you in Zhentil Keep. In the village of Hap, the mage Akabar Bel Akash works to counter Dracandros. Finally, two excellent warriors have been sent to the Pit to aid you.” The letter is unsigned.
en.journal.45: Journal Entry 45: The centaurs recently had a brush with spiders and Thri-Kreen. The monsters were heading north on what looked like a treasure hunt, probably bound for Myth Drannor. Thri-Kreen can avoid arrows, and their phase spiders are unhittable after they strike.
en.journal.55: Journal Entry 55: “Your aid to one of our fellows in Tilverton was much appreciated. In return we must warn you that the Fire Knives are watching the forest roads for you. Also the Flamed One, in the ruins of Myth Drannor, seems to be taking an interest in you. Finally, something malignant seems to be watching the Standing Stones. Beware, and good luck.”
en.journal.58: Journal Entry 58: A letter in crabbed script reads, “I have deemed the Displacer Beasts too weak for my needs. You are instructed to continue their training in the mountains near Tilverton. It would take too many of them to lay waste to the Dalelands, but I don't want them destroyed when the dragons begin their flight. You will be contacted periodically with new instructions.” The letter is signed with a symbol matching the crescent moon bond on your arm.
en.pit.backdoor-entry: You have entered the pit through its back door. An ominous silence pervades the air.
en.pit.alias-leaves: 'We must leave you now.' Alias thanks you for your help, wishes you luck, and leaves.
en.pit.dragonbait-follows: The smell of honeysuckle fills the air. Dragonbait looks quietly at each character in turn, bows, and follows Alias.
en.pit.dragonbait-carries-alias: Dragonbait picks up the body of Alias, turns to you in sorrow, and starts running towards Hillsfar.
en.pit.vegepygmies-retreat: You come upon some vegepygmies. They back away, pointing at the door behind you.
en.pit.shambling-mounds-attack: You are attacked by shambling mounds!
en.pit.shambling-mounds-push: Some shambling mounds are trying to push the party back into the corridor.
en.pit.giant-slugs: Giant slugs are crossing your path.
en.pit.mogion-image-summons: An image appears before you. She says, 'Oh no, my pets. You must not leave now. You are the guests of honour at our sacred rites. Come to me in the lower level.'
en.pit.pushed-back: A strong force pushes the party back into the room.
en.pit.awake-in-pain: The party wakes in a fog of pain.
en.pit.mogion-heal-victims: “I need to have my victims healthy. Send them to a room until they have regained their strength.”
en.pit.dead-cultist-blood: A dead cultist lies in a pool of fresh blood, and the sounds of battle come from the door to the south.
en.pit.baked-bread-and-rictus: Again that vague smell of baked bread. A bleeding cleric crawls out of the door to the north; as he turns and sees the party, his face deforms into a rictus grin.
en.pit.cleric-dies-praising-moander: The cleric says, “Moander be praised. The sacrifice can continue,” and dies — his dead features still grinning in horrid triumph.
en.pit.ringing-weapons-and-ichor: Weapons ring to the north. Green ichor covers the floor and walls, and a shambling mound lies in pieces at the party's feet; the squeal of vegepygmies and shouts of men come from the south.
en.pit.bread-smell-stronger: The baked bread smell is stronger. Through the door to the west lies a pile of dead clerics, shambling mounds and vegepygmies.
en.pit.cleric-crashes-through-door: A cleric comes crashing through the door and dies at the party's feet. The baked bread smell is overpowered by the scent of tar.
en.pit.lemon-scent-way-out: A slight tang of lemon hangs in the air. Alias says, “Dragonbait smells fresh air. There must be a way out around here.” Further on the lemon scent grows strong: “This is where Dragonbait smelled the fresh air.”
en.pit.brimstone-smell: The party smells brimstone. Alias looks at Dragonbait for a moment.
en.pit.alias-crawling-with-monsters: Alias nods. “I don't like this either. This place was crawling with monsters before you guys showed up.” Dragonbait looks disturbed about something.
en.pit.altar-on-lower-level: Alias says, “I think the altar must be on the lower level.”
en.pit.alias-rotting-heap: Alias mutters, “I can't believe they're bringing back that rotting heap of garbage. Who could worship a god like that?”
en.pit.peasant-fed-to-slug: A large group of cultists is feeding a peasant to a giant slug. Alias blanches; the smell of baked bread fills the air.
en.pit.altar-entrance-violets: Alias says, “This is it, the entrance to the altar of Mogion.” The party smells violets — and is attacked by cultists of Moander.
en.pit.alias-bursts-out: Alias and Dragonbait burst out of the door to the east.
en.pit.alias-offers-help: Alias says, “Listen, Mogion is about to raise Moander again. Let us help you!”
en.pit.baked-bread-again: Again, that vague smell of baked bread.
en.pit.bleeding-cleric-grins: A bleeding cleric crawls out of the door to the north. As he turns and sees the party, his face deforms into a rictus grin.
en.pit.green-ichor: Green ichor covers the floor and walls, and a shambling mound lies in pieces at the party's feet. The squeal of vegepygmies and shouts of men come from the south.
en.pit.bread-smell-stronger-only: The baked bread smell is stronger.
en.pit.pile-of-dead: Through the door to the west lies a pile of dead clerics, shambling mounds and vegepygmies.
en.pit.deathly-quiet: A sudden, deathly quiet descends over the surroundings.
en.pit.fighter-were-on-your-side: The fighter says, “What the hell are you doing? We're on your side! Let's get away from these idiots.”
en.pit.slip-past-and-disappear: They quickly slip past the party and disappear.
en.pit.they-leave-roses: They leave. The party smells roses.
en.pit.lemon-tang: A slight tang of lemon hangs in the air. Alias says, “Dragonbait smells fresh air. There must be a way out around here.”
en.pit.strong-lemon: A strong lemon scent permeates the air. Alias says, “This is where Dragonbait smelled the fresh air.”
en.pit.dark-elf-took-the-name: “So, the dark elf has taken the name of the organisation I supposedly belonged to. That's something I'll have to investigate.”
en.pit.exchange-glances: Alias and Dragonbait exchange glances. The scent of baked bread briefly crosses the party's nostrils.
en.pit.you-lie: “You lie! You must tell me the truth!” What will the party do?
en.pit.alias-charges: Before the party can run, Alias and Dragonbait charge.
en.pit.altar-entrance: Alias says, “This is it, the entrance to the altar of Mogion.” The party smells violets.
en.pit.attacked-by-cultists: The party is attacked by cultists of Moander.
en.pit.alias-introduces: The fighter introduces herself as Alias and her companion as Dragonbait. She mentions that she once had tattoos similar to the party's.
en.pit.tell-your-story: She asks the party to tell their story.
en.pit.its-your-dead-body: “OK, it's your dead body.” Alias and Dragonbait leave.
en.pit.alias-joins-treasure: Alias and Dragonbait join the party. Alias says, “There's also the matter of the treasure that is kept behind the altar.”
en.pit.alias-joins-journal-3: Alias and Dragonbait join the party. As Alias tells her story, the party notes it down as Journal Entry 3.
en.pit.surrounded-by-chanting: The party is surrounded by cultists chanting in a low drone.
en.pit.alias-hacked-free: Alias has hacked her way free. She hisses, “Attack them now, unless you wish to fight a god!” What will the party do?
en.pit.dragonbait-frees-himself: Dragonbait frees himself and waits expectantly for the party's decision. What will they do?
en.pit.whole-place-after-us: Alias grumbles, “Oh hell, now the whole place will be after us.” She sighs and looks about in disgust, then brightens: “The treasure is supposed to be in the altar.”
en.pit.alias-grabs-hand: Alias grabs one of the party by the hand: “Where did you get this tattoo?” What will they do?
en.zhentil.arena-rules: The arena rules are explained. The party notes them down as Journal Entry 23.
en.zhentil.mercenary-briefing: A man shakes your hand: “You must be the mercenary group.” He explains the situation, and the party records it as Journal Entry 36.
en.zhentil.depart-invasion: As the party departs, a huge force of Zhentil Keep troops invades the city from the north.
en.zhentil.depart-civil-war: As the party leaves, civil war erupts: many factions are using the havoc to settle old scores.
en.zhentil.court.dragged-in: In a foggy haze the party is dragged into the courtroom. The magistrate looks up and smiles with anticipation.
en.zhentil.court.cell-until-trial: The magistrate orders the party into a cell to rest up for the trial.
en.zhentil.court.session: “Oyez, oyez. The court of Zhentil is now in session. You are on trial for malicious conduct against the state. How do you plea?”
en.zhentil.tavern.drink-prompt: “What can I get you to drink?”
en.zhentil.street.halfling-scuttles: A small halfling scuttles about in the distance.
en.zhentil.street.dog-piddles: A dog piddles on someone's leg.
en.zhentil.street.loose-money-pouch: Some off-duty Zhentarim soldiers walk down the street with bulging purses. A pickpocket in the party notices that one of them has his money pouch very loosely attached.
en.zhentil.street.guards-crash-out: Some Zhentil Keep guards come crashing out of the tavern and glare at the party suspiciously as it passes.
en.zhentil.street.legless-soldier: A legless soldier sits in a little cart. When he spots the party he points and starts to yell: “Yulash! You're the ones who… you… you…”
en.zhentil.street.you-killed-fritz: “You killed Fritz!” He starts grunting incoherently and pushes himself off down the street.
en.zhentil.street.body-dragged: The crowds have thinned out a bit. A group of people drags a body around the corner.
en.zhentil.street.fresh-blood: Fresh blood is splashed against the wall.
en.zhentil.street.rotten-food: Rotten food drops on the party from an open window.
en.zhentil.street.city-gone-silent: The city has gone silent and the streets are deserted; an ominous dread seeps into the party's bones.
en.zhentil.street.ones-she-told-us-about: “Aren't those the ones she told us about…?”
en.zhentil.street.people-run-indoors: People are running indoors and shutting their windows.
en.zhentil.street.woman-and-child: A woman and her young child start to pass close by; she grabs the child in panic and rushes off.
en.zhentil.shop.then-get-out: “Then get out!” The guards eye the party suspiciously.
en.zhentil.inn.rooms-available: “We got rooms ya can stay in. Ya gonna stay?”
en.zhentil.court.no-trial: The party is in the courthouse of Zhentil Keep. No trial is currently in session.
en.zhentil.halfling.hard-way: “You'll just have to do this the hard way then!” … “Back again. Coming this time?” The halfling ducks through a small opening and disappears.
en.zhentil.temple.priests-rush-out: Priests of Bane rush from the temple; others wait just inside the temple door.
en.zhentil.temple.surrender-demand: A much larger group of reinforcements rushes out of the temple yelling for surrender. Will the party surrender?
en.zhentil.temple.dark-temple: The party stands before the dark temple of Bane.
en.zhentil.street.private-home: The party has broken into a private home. There is nothing of interest here, and the magistrate has been notified of a public disturbance.
en.zhentil.street.magistrates-office: “Hey you! Get outta the magistrate's office!”
en.zhentil.fzoul-bond-compels: The bond of Fzoul on the party's arms suddenly gives off a blue glow. An unavoidable compulsion takes hold: draw weapons and attack.
en.zhentil.temple.attacked-by-priests: The party is attacked by the priests of Bane.
en.zhentil.temple.secret-door-west: The party finds a secret door to the west.
en.zhentil.temple.secret-door-east: The party finds a secret door to the east.
en.zhentil.temple.banes-blessing: “Sorry to disturb you. Bane's blessing on you.” The priests leave. As they talk, one starts to move away — possibly to warn others. Does the party attack?
en.zhentil.temple.priests-stalling: The priests keep talking; the party suspects they are stalling. What will they do?
en.zhentil.temple.spotted-by-patrol: The party is spotted by a patrol of priests!
en.zhentil.temple.door-below-altar: The party notices a small door below the altar. What will they do?
en.zhentil.temple.mirror-room: Many mirrors hang from the ceiling of this room in no apparent order. As the party walks, different mirrors activate in passing, and vague shapes shimmer inside their glassy surfaces.
en.zhentil.sign.inn: Zhentil Inn — no Red Plumes allowed!
en.zhentil.sign.crossed-swords: A pair of crossed swords hangs over the doorway.
en.zhentil.sign.gorge-and-grog: The Gorge and Grog — arena combat betting.
en.zhentil.street.troops-take-bodies: Just before the party passes out from pain, troops rush up and force their foes to give up their semi-conscious bodies.
en.zhentil.street.take-them-to-magistrate: Zhentil Keep troopers and mages rush the party, yelling, “There they are! Are they the ones? … The hell with this. Let's take them to the magistrate.”
en.zhentil.street.fzoul-will-deal: “Those are the ones! Lord Fzoul will deal with them!”
en.zhentil.street.blessings-of-bane: “May the blessings of Bane go with you.”
en.zhentil.street.she-ducks-into-crowd: She ducks into the crowd and disappears.
en.zhentil.street.not-healthy-enough: That character is not healthy enough.
en.zhentil.street.drunken-pickpocket: The thief acts like a drunk coming out of the tavern, stumbles into the Zhentarim soldier and starts apologising in the most piteous, drunken manner.
en.zhentil.street.dagger-in-his-side: As the dagger enters his side, he realises he will probably need more practice. The rest of the guards draw their weapons and attack, and the party wades into the fray.
en.zhentil.street.glare-suspiciously: They glare at the party suspiciously as it passes by.
en.zhentil.street.crowds-thinned: The crowds have thinned out a bit.
en.zhentil.street.body-around-corner: A group of people drags a body around the corner.
en.zhentil.rumor.no-decent-mark: The party overhears: “You can't find a decent mark anywhere. Everybody's a mage or a priest with magical protection. Now Phlan, there's a city for a slippery hand.”
en.zhentil.shop.guards-eye-you: The guards eye the party suspiciously.
en.zhentil.halfling.the-hard-way: “You'll just have to do this the hard way then!”
en.zhentil.halfling.ducks-through: The halfling ducks through a small opening and disappears.
en.zhentil.court.first-wave-defeated: The party has defeated the first wave of guards, but others are pouring into the room! What will they do?
en.zhentil.temple.sealed-by-priest: A blinding flash envelops the main doors. A priest stands in an open doorway with a crumbling scroll in his hands and yells, “I have sealed the temple. The heretics are trapped!” He ducks behind a door and is gone.
en.zhentil.temple.hooded-figure-leaves: “Unlike you, I cannot remain here.” The hooded figure disappears!
en.zhentil.temple.traced-the-magic: A large group bursts in: “We have traced the magic to here!”
en.zhentil.temple.sorry-to-disturb: “Sorry to disturb you. Bane's blessing on you.” The priests leave.
en.zhentil.temple.one-moves-away: As the priests talk, one starts to move away — possibly to warn others. Does the party attack?
en.zhentil.temple.gas-cloud: A cloud of gas envelops the party!
en.zhentil.temple.no-detect-trap: No detect trap spell in the party.
en.zhentil.temple.detects-a-trap: Someone detects a trap! What will the party do?
en.zhentil.temple.scrying-room: Dimswart looks about in awe: “This is a scrying room. Fzoul must be spying on all the different creatures in Zhentil Keep that could potentially be used against him.”
en.zhentil.temple.olive-in-crevice: Olive Ruskettle is squeezing through a small crevice, surrounded by rock. By the movement of her lips, the air is clearly turning blue in her vicinity.
en.zhentil.court.fine: The fine is 95 percent of the party's money and 20 percent of all other items.
en.zhentil.court.send-to-arena: “Send them to the arena, where their worthiness to remain in Zhentil Keep will be tested.”
en.zhentil.arena.dragged-in: The party is dragged into the arena — a large open space where the dirt is scuffed and stained a suspicious reddish brown.
en.zhentil.arena.fanfare: The surrounding walls are pierced with windows and packed with people watching in anticipation. A great, blaring fanfare sounds.
en.zhentil.arena.gladiators-attack: The party is attacked by gladiators!
en.zhentil.court.bane-smiles: The party is escorted back outside. The magistrate says from his door, “Bane smiles on you. You may go in peace.”
en.zhentil.tavern.moo-juice: The proprietor chuckles and cries in a loud voice, “Get these ‘adventurers' some moo-juice!”
en.zhentil.tavern.gamble-prompt: Would the party like to gamble on the arena combats?
en.zhentil.tavern.deadbeats: “Then get out of my establishment! Deadbeats.”
en.zhentil.tavern.stay-prompt: Does the party want to stay in the tavern?
en.zhentil.arena.condemned-vs-monsters: The condemned prisoners versus the monsters of Zhentil Keep! Who does the party pick?
en.zhentil.arena.accused-vs-monsters: The accused versus the monsters of Zhentil Keep! Who does the party pick?
en.zhentil.arena.prisoners-won: The fight is on! Unbelievable — those ragged prisoners actually won. “I'm very sorry, perhaps next time?”
en.zhentil.arena.prisoners-lost: The fight is on! The prisoners lost — so what else is new? “I'm very sorry, perhaps next time?”
en.zhentil.arena.decreed-guilty: The fight is on! Bane has decreed the prisoners guilty. “I'm very sorry, perhaps next time?”
en.zhentil.arena.accused-innocent: The fight is on! Bane is merciful — the accused are innocent. “I'm very sorry, perhaps next time?”
en.zhentil.arena.killed-each-other: The fight is on! They have killed each other. “I'm very sorry, perhaps next time?”
en.zhentil.tavern.cant-afford: The party can't afford it. “Anyone else have any money?”
en.zhentil.street.soldier-cuffs: The soldier cuffs one of the party on the head, laughs and goes on his way. The thief grins slyly in triumph.
en.lava-tube.silk-mark-offer: Silk continues, and the party records it as Journal Entry 44. Will the chosen character step forward?
en.lava-tube.cask-unhealthy: That character is not healthy enough.
en.lava-tube.cask-try-another: Will the party try for another cask?
en.lava-tube.casks-emptied: All the casks have been emptied.
en.lava-tube.exit-to-wilderness: This route leads out to the wilderness. Will the party continue?
en.lava-tube.return-or-beyond: Will the party return to Haptooth Village or head beyond?
en.lava-tube.blocked-rubble: The way is blocked with rubble.
en.lava-tube.patrol-attacks: A patrol spots the party and attacks.
en.lava-tube.elves-see-mark: A party of elves spots the group but sees Silk's mark and moves away.
en.lava-tube.too-weak-toll: “You are too weak. We will take some of your treasure, and then you can head on to Crimdrac.”
en.lava-tube.patrol-escort: A patrol approaches from behind. Four female dark elves step from the shadows: “We were expecting you. We will escort you to our commander, who has a proposition you may be interested in.”
en.lava-tube.silk-symbol-luck: “I wish you good luck. The symbol may make some patrols avoid you, but it won't be completely safe. Some of the guards are related to me, and I still have influence in family affairs, though not in racial ones.”
en.lava-tube.silk-refused: “That is too bad. Perhaps you will change your mind later. I can be of no more help.” She leaves.
en.lava-tube.silk-needs-a-woman: “It is too bad you have no women. Only they can wear our mark. I am afraid I can be of no more help until one joins you.” She leaves.
en.lava-tube.violated-our-precinct: Some dark elves stand atop a mound of freshly turned earth: “You have violated our precinct. Your life is forfeit.” Strange shapes rise up behind them.
en.lava-tube.barracks-disturbed: The party has disturbed a barracks full of dark elves, who rise up in anger.
en.lava-tube.incense-room: This room is filled with cloying incense smoke. A large number of dark elven clerics lie on pillows, smoking from hookahs.
en.lava-tube.move-on-sister: One of the clerics speaks: “Move on, sister. We should have no quarrel.” Does the party retreat?
en.lava-tube.mage-meditation-room: Mystic symbols adorn the walls. Mages meditate and chant here; one begins to speak.
en.lava-tube.dangerous-ground-sister: “You tread on dangerous ground, sister. Retreat now lest we be forced to raise our hands against you.” Does the party retreat?
en.lava-tube.crimdrac-introduces: Curled in the centre of this room is the huge skeletal form of a dracolich. “I am Crimdrac, mortalsss. You have reached the heart of my domain. It pleassesss me to let you live.”
en.lava-tube.crimdrac-foolishness: “Foolisshnesss wasss alwaysss in a mortal'sss heart. Perhapsss you will reconsssider later.”
en.lava-tube.crimdrac-short-walk: Crimdrac rounds the party up and takes them on a short walk.
en.lava-tube.crimdrac-greetings: He gives the party a push up a ramp: “Give my greetingsss to Dracandrosss.” This way is guarded by efreeti and dark elves.
en.lava-tube.tunnel-collapsed: At the party's approach the elves collapse the tunnel. A voice carries: “None shall reach the divine city.”
en.lava-tube.silk-buys-heart: Silk steps out from the shadows: “Congratulations on your successes. I will pay you well for the dragon's black heart and black eggs, if you are interested. Are you?”
en.lava-tube.arrow-in-ash: An arrow pointing west is faintly scratched in the ash.
en.lava-tube.stone-arrow-south: An arrow made of small stones points south.
en.lava-tube.four-dark-elves: Four female dark elves step from the shadows: “We were expecting you. We will escort you to our commander, who has a proposition you may be interested in.”
en.lava-tube.next-cavern: “As you wish. We will be in the next cavern if you change your mind.”
en.lava-tube.paranoid-fools: “Paranoid fools!” they cry as they scatter and escape into the shadows.
en.lava-tube.silk-steps-forward: A dark elven woman steps forward. Her hair is dark with a single streak of white, and on the back of her hand is a symbol resembling a stylised swan.
en.lava-tube.guarded-by-efreeti: This way is guarded by efreeti and dark elves.
en.lava-tube.silk-marks-hand: One of the party steps forward. Silk passes her hand over the back of their hand, and a tattoo of a stylised swan appears.
en.lava-tube.carry-our-mark: “Then take care, and carry our mark proudly. The safest way out should be through the secret door.”
en.world.night-note.35: Another note is pinned to a companion's chest; the party records it as Journal Entry 35.
en.world.night-note.42: A third note is pinned to a companion's chest; the party records it as Journal Entry 42.
en.world.centaur-village: The centaurs take the party to their village and exchange tales, recorded as Journal Entry 45. Then the two parties go their separate ways.
en.world.myth-drannor-scouts-camp: In the evening the group in Myth Drannor livery invites the party to their camp and talks; the party records it as Journal Entry 55.
en.world.inn-dark-elf-letter: The innkeeper says the dark elf arrived some days ago. There is a letter in his room, recorded as Journal Entry 58.
en.world.bridge-riddle.intro: An impassable chasm blocks the way. A narrow bridge is guarded by an old man who cackles, “You must answer me before the other side ye see.”
en.world.wilderness.night-siege: All is not well: indistinct shapes circle the building, and a battle is inevitable if the party is going to get any sleep.
en.world.wilderness.displacer-collars: The displacer beasts are wearing collars. Nearby lies a dark elf slain by the beasts.
en.world.wilderness.voonlar-stragglers: Travelling south, the party is passed by the stragglers of a defeated army bearing the banner of Voonlar. Amidst the fields of Daggerdale, huge footprints lead toward a small farm, and in the setting sun the silhouettes of giants stand out.
en.world.wilderness.lizardmen-riverbank: Lizard men rush out of a swampy section of the riverbank.
en.world.wilderness.myth-drannor-livery: A group wearing the livery of Myth Drannor parallels the party through the forest; when the party tries to close, they melt into the underbrush. In the evening they invite the party to their camp and talk.
en.world.wilderness.centaur-hospitality: Centaurs approach and offer the party their hospitality.
en.world.city-gate.combat-too-heavy: The fighting is too heavy to enter. The guards say the city is sealed pending a reorganization of the government.
en.world.wilderness.used-path-north: Travelling through the wilds, the party comes upon a heavily used path leading north.
en.world.wilderness.craggy-peak-patrol: The trail climbs into a craggy wilderness and ends below a gigantic peak, where a squad of Zhentil Keep troopers comes out to meet the party.
en.world.wilderness.green-robed-followers: A group in green robes is following the party.
en.world.wilderness.yulash-forest-slash: Near Yulash the party finds a great slash cut through the forest to the south.
en.world.wilderness.filth-lair: After several miles it ends in a huge pile of decaying filth that monsters now use as a lair.
en.world.town.sewer-entrance: The party finds an entrance to the sewers.
en.world.town.abuzz-about-akabar: The town is abuzz about Akabar, who freed Hap from horrid monsters.
en.world.tavern.drank-the-night-away: After drinking the night away, the party wakes in the inn.
en.world.wilderness.giant-footprints: Amidst the fields of Daggerdale the party finds huge footprints leading toward a small farm; in the rays of the setting sun stand the silhouettes of giants. What will they do?
en.world.wilderness.farmer-thanks: The farmer's family comes up and thanks the party heartily. They are invited in and enjoy the first home-cooked meal in many days.
en.world.wilderness.morning-farewell: In the morning they wish the party luck and see them off.
en.world.wilderness.nacacia-rides-by: A young woman with a purple sash races by on horseback. Moments later a man with a hammer rides past, and as he fades into the distance a call carries back: “Nacacia… wait.”
en.world.wilderness.regrets-accepted: They accept the party's regrets and leave.
en.world.tavern.wake-in-alley: The party wakes with splitting headaches and light purses in an alley behind the bar.
en.world.wilderness.voonlar-vanguard: Halfway to Voonlar the party spots the vanguard of an army heading south along the road, bearing the banner of Voonlar. What will they do?
en.world.wilderness.marching-on-shadowdale: The party is taken to the officers, who say they are marching on Shadowdale. Noting the sigils on the party's arms, they will let them pass. What will the party do?
en.world.wilderness.penalty-for-spying: The first officer the party meets states flatly: “The penalty for spying is death. Slay them.”
en.world.wilderness.army-routs-north: The rest of the army, confused by the sudden demise of its lead forces, routs back to the north.
en.world.wilderness.robes-thrown-off: They throw off their robes and attack.
en.world.wilderness.chosen-ones-to-yulash: They say they are following the “chosen ones” to Yulash.
en.world.city-gate.city-sealed: The guards inform the party that the city is sealed, pending a reorganisation of the government.
en.dark-elf-caves.items-fade: The party's dark elf items fade away in the sunlight.
en.dark-elf-caves.fresh-air-exit: A breath of fresh air reaches the party. Will they take the exit?
en.dark-elf-caves.tarsus-offer: “Greetings travellers, and welcome to my humble abode. I am Tarsus and, for a tithe, I can transport you back to the surface. Interested?”
en.dark-elf-caves.tarsus-declined: “I travel rarely, so you should find me here if you change your mind.”
en.dark-elf-caves.dark-pit: The party has entered a dark pit.
en.dark-elf-caves.twisting-cavern: The party has entered a twisting cavern.
en.dark-elf-caves.drow-left-with-girl: The drow have left with the girl.
en.dark-elf-caves.girl-fled: During the fight the girl fled in panic; she is nowhere to be seen.
en.dark-elf-caves.maiden-and-dragons: A lovely maiden is being menaced by fierce black dragons. Does the party want to save her?
en.dark-elf-caves.girl-asks-shadowdale: The girl escapes, but the dragons rush after her. Later she smiles demurely: “Thank you, kind warriors. You have saved me. Return me to Shadowdale, and my father will pay you handsomely.” Will the party take her back?
en.dark-elf-caves.surface-thanks: The party retraces its path and reaches the surface. People gather round and give thanks; one older man pushes forward: “You are very brave warriors. Here, take all I can spare.”
en.dark-elf-caves.woman-devoured: “I will try on my own. Still, thank you for your help.” The woman is devoured; then the dragons turn on the party, and it is clear the gods will not favour them in this battle.
en.dark-elf-caves.young-man-calls-protector: The party spots a young man carrying a large gem. When he notices them he turns: “You are becoming tiresome. I call the Protector!” A shimmer appears between them.
en.dark-elf-caves.protector-arrives: A hideous skeletal form appears between them. From behind comes a scream: “The Protector arrives. Slay them, slay, slay, slay!” The monster strikes.
en.dark-elf-caves.body-fades: The body fades away. The man has run off.
en.dark-elf-caves.gem-dashed: The man turns: “You shall never have it! Since you insist on pursuit, then die!” He dashes the gem to the ground; a huge fire roars up and consumes him, and shapes form out of the flame.
en.dark-elf-caves.gem-remains-valuable: The remains of the gem are still valuable.
en.dark-elf-caves.bloody-altar: The party finds a makeshift altar spattered with fresh blood; bear-like footprints circle it.
en.dark-elf-caves.owl-bear-circle: A low growled chant comes from ahead: a circle of owlbears prances around a single drow. At the party's approach they shuffle to a halt and stare. The drow intones, “Gather the sacrifices, my children.”
en.dark-elf-caves.torn-up-party: The party comes upon a battered group on their way out. One says, “It's pretty fierce down there. The deeper you go the nastier the creatures. Luckily, if you search you can find many ways out.”
en.dark-elf-caves.dank-cavern: The party has entered a dank cavern.
en.dark-elf-caves.wounded-man: The party finds a wounded man. He whispers, “The drow have kidnapped the magistrate's daughter. They are taking her below. Save her.” He expires.
en.dark-elf-caves.rear-guard: The drow turn: “So more surface scum invade our halls. As rear guard, we must defeat them.”
en.dark-elf-caves.try-on-my-own: “I will try on my own. Still, thank you for your help.”
en.dark-elf-caves.woman-devoured-only: The woman is devoured; then the dragons turn on the party, and it is clear the gods will not favour them in this battle.
en.dark-elf-caves.pursuit-note: The party comes upon a note: “He escaped into the caves and still has the item. We are in pursuit.”
en.dark-elf-caves.ashen-remains: The ashen remains of another party of adventurers lie here; a few items have survived.
en.dark-elf-caves.owl-bear-drawings: The party comes upon crude drawings showing owlbears being created by the hand of a drow. The artwork looks fairly recent.
en.world.dagger-falls.edge: The party is at the edge of Dagger Falls. Will they enter or continue their journey?
